Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world, and we are looking for a motivated and driven individual to join the team.
Cin7 India is proud of our culture and has been officially recognised with Great Place to Work® Certification™.

How you'll make an impact:

As a Product Manager with AI experience, you are the link between our users and our engineering team. You will work with users to understand what they need, and you will have the technical skills to work with engineers to deliver it. A key part of the role is finding where AI can save our customers time and effort in inventory management, and turning those opportunities into features that enterprise users love and trust.

You will explore and shape product ideas by interviewing customers, studying competitors, and testing new technology, including AI models, tools, and open source options. There are many good ideas, but only some can be built. You will work with UX, engineering, and leadership to choose the ones that matter most, and to decide where AI is the right answer and where a simpler solution works better.

What you'll do:

  • Turn business goals into clear software requirements.

  • Find and define AI use cases for Core, such as forecasting, data entry, search, and automation of routine tasks, and write the requirements for each.

  • Rank features based on market research, customer need, and company strategy.

  • Manage project scope by making trade-offs between time and cost, and between security and speed.

  • Set success measures for AI features, such as accuracy, time saved, and user adoption, and track them after launch.

  • Work with engineers to decide how to build, test, and monitor AI features, including how we handle wrong or unexpected results.

  • Work with Security, Legal, and Engineering to handle customer data responsibly in AI features, including privacy, data use, and cost of running the models.

  • Rank feature requests from the development teams.

  • Set the product vision and work closely with the technical team to define specifications.

  • Make sure the product meets business goals and user needs.

  • Track progress against plan and fix variances as soon as they appear.

  • Make trade-offs between features, schedule, and cost, based on business goals, company policies, software architecture, and team capacity.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven work experience in product management or as an associate product manager, preferably in B2B SaaS, with inventory management, supply chain, or ecommerce domain experience a plus.

  • Hands-on experience shipping at least one product or feature that uses AI or machine learning, including large language models.

  • Working understanding of how AI features are built and tested, such as prompts, model selection, evaluation, accuracy, and data quality. You do not need to write code.

  • Awareness of AI risks, including incorrect answers, bias, privacy, and cost, and how to reduce them.

  • Proven track record of managing a successful product through its full lifecycle.

  • Proven ability to develop product and marketing strategies and present recommendations to executive management.

  • Structured approach and experience with agile methods.

  • History of working with development teams to get results.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to roll up your sleeves.

  • Skilled at working with cross-functional teams in a matrix organization.

  • Enthusiasm for new technology and a practical view of what it can and cannot do.

  • Ability to be productive in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Why Work for Us?

  • We are a fast growing business going through a huge amount of growth.
  • You’ll have the opportunity to work on products that are used by our global customer-base and at the same time you’ll be growing your career and developing new skills.
  • Work From Anywhere for 30 days in a six month period
  • Celebrate your birthday with a paid day off
  • A Global Cin7 Day celebrated companywide, providing you a dedicated holiday to focus on your own wellbeing.
  • Recruitment referral bonus
  • Work for a Great Place to Work®

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. jobs.description:
This role is part of our ScraperAPI team, one of our growing brands at saas.group.

ScraperAPI is an enterprise-scale web scraping solution, trusted by businesses across a wide range of industries to extract crucial data at scale. From e-commerce, travel to real estate and market research, we support companies in turning the web into actionable insights. We're currently on an exciting growth journey, scaling rapidly as demand for reliable, high-performance web scraping and data keeps rising.

Profile Overview

This is the hard end of web scraping. The sites we rely on, Google, Amazon, Walmart and many others, actively work to block us, and they change the rules without warning. We're looking for a senior engineer who can go deep on why we're being blocked, work out how the detection actually functions, and design repeatable ways around it. You'll be joining a self-driven, high-autonomy team to take on our most involved problems, with the room and the trust to build something from close to a blank page: an environment that turns one-off breakthroughs into a methodical, repeatable way of defeating anti-bot systems. If you like confronting problems that genuinely resist you, and you work methodically rather than by trial and error, this is an unusually open brief.

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

  • Getting a full local environment running and becoming fluent in our systems and how they operate, in the first few weeks.
  • Contributing to a proposal on the design for a repeatable environment we can pose anti-bot problems to and get reliable analysis out of.
  • Building that environment out over the following months so that, by month six, we can point it at a target or provider and have it reliably tell us how we're being blocked and what is and isn't being used against us.

Your responsibilities

  • Analyse how specific anti-bot and bot-mitigation systems (the likes of DataDome, Cloudflare Turnstile, Kasada, PerimeterX and Akamai) detect and block us, and design systems to work around them.
  • Turn isolated breakthroughs into durable, repeatable processes: hypothesis, test, discard what's wrong, move on.
  • In collaboration with other senior team members, design and build a greenfield agentic environment that can propose and run tests on anti-bot behaviour and bypass approaches, and do it in a way that's well understood and repeatable.
  • Work largely independently on deep, concentrated problems, while actively pulling in knowledge from across the wider engineering team.
  • Communicate clearly what you plan to do, and step into major incidents when the team needs your depth.

What you bring to the table

  • Deep, genuine understanding of how the internet works underneath: HTTP, TLS and fingerprinting, proxies, headers, cookies, and browser behaviour. This is the core of the role and it isn't something we can shortcut.
  • Excellent problem-solving built on a scientific, methodical approach: you form a hypothesis, design a test, read the result honestly, and iterate. Trying things at random is the opposite of what this role needs.
  • Strong hands-on skills in our stack, Node.js and TypeScript with solid Python, and comfort across backend systems at scale (Postgres, Redis/Valkey, MongoDB, Puppeteer/Camoufox, Kubernetes).
  • Real skill at directing AI coding agents with precision, and the judgement to tell strong output from weak. The specific tool doesn't matter (Claude, Codex or similar); knowing how to steer it well is what counts.
  • A background that has given you this kind of depth and rigour. That might be scraping, anti-bot or web-security work, reverse engineering, or a research or academic path where you built your own tooling and lived by the scientific method. Direct scraping experience is a strong plus rather than a strict requirement.
  • Independence and strong communication: you're comfortable owning hard problems in a remote-first team with little hand-holding, and you keep the team in the loop on your thinking as you go.

What's in it for you

  • Ultimate flexibility: We're 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We're a high-trust team, and you'll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way, with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don't like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

ScraperAPI is part of saas.group and we have a shared goal of succeeding together.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400 colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

We don't just simply offer you to "take a job with us" but rather to "join us on this journey" to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you're up for? Feel free to apply even if you don't check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

jobs.title: Security Solutions Engineer
jobs.excerpt: When a customer hits a thorny technical question, someone at Expel needs to have the answer.
jobs.description:
When a customer hits a thorny technical question, someone at Expel needs to have the answer. Fast, accurate, and complete. That's where you come in.

As a Security Solutions Engineer (SSE), you're the technical backstop for our Customer Success organization. When our Customer Success Managers (CSMs), Technical Account Managers (TAMs), and Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) run into complex technical challenges, you're the person they turn to. You'll dig in, troubleshoot, and deliver answers that help our customers get the most out of Expel.

You'll work closely with a team of technical experts and collaborate across Security, Detection & Response Engineering, and other Engineering teams to build a deep understanding of our platform, integrations, detection strategies, and security operations. Just as importantly, you'll turn that knowledge into documentation, enablement, and repeatable solutions that help the broader organization become more effective over time.

Success in this role comes from having a "the buck stops here" mindset. You're someone who takes ownership, enjoys solving complex problems, and knows how to balance being a trusted technical resource with helping others become more self-sufficient.

What Expel can do for you

  • Give you the opportunity to work with a wide variety of security technologies, platforms, and customer environments.
  • Deepen your expertise in managed detection and response (MDR), security operations, and the broader cybersecurity landscape.
  • Connect you with experienced security practitioners, engineers, and leaders across Expel and our customer base.
  • Provide hands-on exposure to complex technical challenges that require creative problem-solving and thoughtful troubleshooting.
  • Help you sharpen your consultative skills as you translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Give you the opportunity to influence how our Customer Success organization operates through documentation, enablement, and process improvements.
  • Surround you with a collaborative team that values technical curiosity, knowledge-sharing, and continuous improvement.

What you can do for Expel

  • Serve as a trusted technical resource and escalation point for our Customer Success organization, providing timely, accurate, and thorough responses to technical questions.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and help identify practical solutions that improve customer outcomes.
  • Partner with CSMs, TAMs, and TSEs to address technical challenges, occasionally joining customer conversations when deeper technical expertise is needed.
  • Collaborate with Security, Detection & Response Engineering, and other Engineering teams to develop a strong understanding of Expel's platform architecture, integrations, data flows, and detection and response capabilities.
  • Identify gaps in existing documentation and proactively create, maintain, and improve internal and external knowledge resources.
  • Help enable Customer Success teams to answer common technical questions independently, reducing repetitive inquiries and improving response times.
  • Maintain accurate records of technical inquiries, including request types and trends, to help the team identify recurring challenges and prioritize improvements.
  • Contribute to the team's operational processes, helping improve how technical requests are tracked, escalated, resolved, and documented.
  • Share your expertise with teammates and help build a culture of continuous learning, collaboration, and technical excellence.

What you should bring with you

  • 5+ years of experience in the cybersecurity industry, ideally with exposure to technical troubleshooting, security operations, or consultative customer-facing roles.
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with the ability to independently investigate and resolve complex technical challenges.
  • Technical depth in one or more security technology areas, including EDR, NDR, SIEM, cloud security, or related security platforms.
  • A solid understanding of detection strategies, security operations workflows, and the technical tradeoffs associated with different security solutions.
  • Familiarity with common attack vectors, threat tactics and techniques, frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, and the broader attack lifecycle.
  • Working knowledge of the cybersecurity landscape, including security products, service providers, and their relative strengths and limitations.
  • An understanding of security controls across common operating systems, cloud environments, and enterprise technologies, including Windows, Unix/Linux, AWS, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and network infrastructure.
  • Experience working with ticketing, case management, or operational workflow platforms such as Zendesk, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical practitioners and business stakeholders.
  • A consultative approach to problem-solving, including active listening, thoughtful questioning, and the ability to understand the underlying issue before recommending a solution.
  • Sound judgment when prioritizing competing requests, managing challenging conversations, and knowing when to escalate.
  • A collaborative, curious mindset and a genuine interest in learning, sharing knowledge, and continuously improving how work gets done.
  • Awareness of how security challenges and priorities can differ across customer industries and environments.
  • A bachelor's degree or relevant security certifications are a plus, but they're not required.

Additional notes

The full base salary range for this role is $102,000 to $147,900 USD, plus bonus eligibility and equity. While this represents the full range for the position, we're targeting a base salary between $115,000 and $137,500 USD for this hire, depending on experience, skills, and other relevant factors.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your compensation will ultimately be determined based on your experience, skills, internal team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and excellent health benefits.

This role is open to candidates residing within the continental United States. Employees may work remotely from their home office if they are not located near Expel's headquarters in Herndon, VA. Some travel to customer sites may be required, generally not exceeding 20%.

We're only hiring individuals authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer. You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

jobs.excerpt: About OpenSesameOpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways.
jobs.description:
About OpenSesame

OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.

Learn more:

About the Team

OpenSesame is entering a new phase of growth — evolving from a product-led to a multi-product, AI-enhanced SaaS company. The Sales Development (SDR) team sits at the forefront of this transformation. As our Sales Development Manager you’ll lead the team that fuels our outbound pipeline, engages in meaningful conversations with L&D and HR leaders, and sets the standard for what modern, human-centered, AI-powered outbound looks like.

About the Role

This role is about more than managing activity. You’ll scale a predictable outbound engine, develop future sales talent, and redefine how OpenSesame connects with the market — through a balance of technology, creativity, and empathy.

You’ll blend strategy and execution, building an SDR function that leverages AI tools to enhance research, messaging and timely coaching, while keeping the human touch at the heart of every interaction. You will work closely with Marketing, Partners, Sales, Enablement and RevOps, to turn insight into action — driving pipeline growth, process consistency, and professional development across the team.

Reporting to the Director of GTM Operations, this is a highly visible leadership role with a direct impact on pipeline, revenue and GTM innovation.

Performance Objectives

First 30 Days - Orientation & Assessment

  • Build a foundational understanding of OpenSesame’s go-to-market strategy, ideal customer profiles, and competitive landscape.
  • Audit existing SDR processes, messaging, and cadences across Gong Engage, Salesforce, and ZoomInfo.
  • Assess SDR performance metrics (activity → meeting, meeting → opportunity, velocity) and identify key bottlenecks.
  • Conduct 1:1s with every SDR, AE, and cross-functional partner to understand strengths, challenges, and development goals.
  • Deliver a baseline performance report and outline 2–3 high-impact quick wins to drive immediate improvement.
  • Outline an execution plan for automated inbound management.

Success by Day 30: Clear SDR performance baseline, planned approach for early optimizations, and a 10+% improvement in activity-to-meeting conversion through data-driven tweaks and workflow efficiency.

By 60 Days - Optimization & Team Enablement

  • Launch the first version of the AI-Enhanced Outbound Playbook, integrating tools like Gong Engage, Qualified, Clay, ZoomInfo and ChatGPT Enterprise to automate research, personalization drafts, lead qualification and post-call notes.
  • Coach SDRs on balancing automation with authentic outreach, reinforcing high-quality engagement and messaging consistency.
  • Partner with Marketing to launch 2–3 account-based outbound campaigns targeting top verticals and / or target account lists.
  • Engage with our Partner organization to improve and enhance our Partner lead processes
  • Establish a weekly coaching rhythm using Gong analytics, call reviews, and performance dashboards to ensure feedback is timely and impactful.
  • Optimize existing dashboards that track inbound and outbound conversion, pipeline creation, and ROI in real time.
  • Establish a closed loop feedback process for capturing seller and sales leader insights in order to continuously improve SDR support.

Success by Day 60: SDRs are operating with greater precision and confidence, with 5-7% improvement in meeting-to-opportunity conversion rates, and new playbook adoption exceeding 90%.

By 90 Days - Predicable Performance & Team Development

  • Drive the SDR team to 100% attainment of monthly qualified opportunity targets, with top performers achieving full quota.
  • Partner with AEs and RevOps to refine qualification criteria and improve lead handoffs.
  • Refine account-based outbound campaigns and create campaign strategy framework for upcoming quarter in partnership with Marketing.
  • Introduce a development framework for SDR → AE progression, identifying high-potential talent for future roles.
  • Implement consistent reporting to the business demonstrating SDR impact on pipeline / revenue while providing analysis on MQL quality to improve Marketing ROI.
  • Strengthen remote team culture through consistent rituals — call-of-the-week breakdowns, win shares, and transparent leaderboard recognition.

Success by Day 90: A confident, data-driven SDR team operating with rhythm and accountability, contributing predictable pipeline and demonstrating measurable skill growth.

By 180 Days - Scale & Systematize

  • Institutionalize a repeatable Outbound Operating System — including training guides, cadences, and KPI dashboards — to support new hire ramp and predictable team performance.
  • Achieve full team quota attainment (100%+ of sales qualified targets).
  • Improve overall outbound conversion rates by 10%+ over baseline through targeted messaging, data refinement, and coaching.
  • Develop and document best practices for AI-assisted prospecting, ensuring consistency in quality and tone across the team.
  • Partner with Marketing to align outbound campaigns with product launches, develop top-of-mind thought leadership and improve campaign strategy.
  • Launch seller satisfaction survey framework to capture seller feedback on SDR performance

Success by Day 180: A fully optimized outbound function that blends automation and authenticity, with measurable improvements in pipeline quality, velocity, and conversion efficiency.

Ongoing – Leadership, Growth & Continuous Improvement

  • Build a high-performance culture of accountability, curiosity, and career growth with proper incentive plans to support.
  • Continuously refine outbound strategies based on performance data and market shifts.
  • Promote SDRs into AE or other roles, building a visible talent pipeline across the revenue organization.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure outbound insights shape company-wide targeting and messaging.
  • Champion a balance of human connection and AI innovation in everything the team does.

12-Month Success Snapshot:

  • SDR team consistently achieving 110% of pipeline creation targets.
  • New hires consistently achieve 100% quota by month 3.
  • 25–30% improvement in outbound conversion rates year over year.
  • A well-documented, scalable outbound system embedded across GTM teams.
  • Visible talent progression, with multiple SDR-to-AE promotions.
  • A reputation for excellence, creativity, and modern outbound leadership

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.

We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location: This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.

Performance Driven: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements; instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.

Compensation: The base salary for this position generally ranges between $110,000 and $119,000, depending on experience, and is bonus eligible. On-target earnings (OTE) range from $157,000 to $170,000. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.

Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

We Care About Your Security: We’ve been made aware of a phishing scam involving individuals impersonating OpenSesame recruiters. All legitimate communication from our team will come from @opensesame.com email addresses. If you receive a suspicious message, please contact us directly at . Your security matters to us, thank you for staying vigilant.

  • Enter and manage charges within eClinicalWorks (eCW)

  • Experience working in eClinicalWorks (eCW) preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and payor billing requirements
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payor guidelines
  • Strong attention to detail with a commitment to coding accuracy and compliance
  • Ability to independently manage priorities and follow work through to resolution in a remote environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Reliable internet access and the ability to maintain a HIPAA-compliant remote workspace

jobs.description:
The Principal Data Scientist is the senior technical and scientific leader for AbbVie's omnichannel engagement analytics, a data- and analytics-driven engagement optimization program spanning channel mix, content, field representative call planning, and orchestration. Operating within the APEX Enterprise Advanced Analytics and Innovation team, this role sets the multi-year science vision for personalized commercial engagement and is accountable for the technical strategy, methodology, and scientific rigor of the AI/ML and statistical solutions that power it. Reporting to the Associate Director, Data Science, the Principal is a thought partner to commercial and analytics leadership: shaping which problems are worth solving, forming and defending a point of view on how AI creates measurable business value, and partnering with product owners to turn that vision into scalable solutions. The role combines deep, hands-on expertise in applied machine learning, generative AI, causal inference, and experimentation with the consultative skill to align a complex stakeholder ecosystem around the right answer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define the Data Science vision: Own the multi-year Data Science vision and technical roadmap for omnichannel engagement analytics, anticipating where both the business and the field of AI are heading.
  • Shape how AI creates business value: identify, size, and prioritize opportunities where AI can drive measurable commercial impact, build the business case, and influence senior leadership decisions on where to invest.
  • Lead hands-on with Gen-AI: Personally use AI-assisted development and agentic tools to prototype, test hypotheses, and demonstrate value quickly; build LLM-backed systems using advanced RAG and context engineering, paired with rigorous scientific evaluation frameworks to scale highly reliable omnichannel recommendations.
  • Lead the design of predictive and causal models: Develop next-best-action, recommendation, and sequential decision models that inform customer engagement and resource allocation using complex, multi-source data.
  • Own measurement science: set the standard for measuring effectiveness, incrementality, and business impact using experimental and quasi-experimental methods, so that AI investments are evaluated rigorously.
  • Partner with product owners to shape problems, not just fulfill requirements: co-define business outcomes, scope, and success metrics, and translate them into scalable technical solutions.
  • Navigate a complex stakeholder ecosystem: build alignment across brand and marketing leaders, field sales and operations, Medical, Legal and Regulatory (MLR), Compliance, BTS, Digital Lab, and external vendors; reframe requests into well-posed problems and resolve competing priorities.
  • Communicate with executive impact: translate complex methods and findings into clear recommendations and compelling narratives for executive and non-technical audiences.
  • Productionize at scale: Partner with BTS, Digital Lab, engineering, and platform teams to deploy, monitor, and manage the lifecycle of AI/ML solutions.
  • Raise the bar for scientific rigor: establish best practices in model development, code quality, reproducibility, peer review, and responsible AI across the data science community.
  • Be a thought leader: stay at the forefront of research and practice in machine learning, generative AI, and causal inference; bring new ideas into the team; provoke rigorous analytical debate; and represent AbbVie's point of view internally and in the broader analytics community.

Supervisory / Management Responsibilities

This role does not carry formal direct report responsibilities but is expected to act as a technical leader and mentor across the broader data science community, raising the bar on scientific rigor and hands-on AI practice. The Principal Data Scientist may lead technical workstreams with external analytics vendors and partners, including oversight of deliverable quality and methodology validation.

Key Competencies

  • Scientific Engineering Depth: Deep expertise in machine learning, causal inference, and generative AI, combined with strong engineering discipline in reproducibility, deployment, and enterprise integration.
  • AI Fluency and Bias to Action: Uses AI hands-on in daily work to prototype, analyze, and build; critically evaluates AI output; and turns ideas into working solutions quickly.
  • Business Judgment and Problem-Framing: Translates ambiguous business challenges into well-scoped problems, connects technical choices to commercial value, and sets long-term technical direction while staying close to delivery.
  • Stakeholder Navigation and Executive Influence: Reads organizational dynamics to build alignment across commercial, regulatory, and technology partners, earning trust as a thought partner to win support from senior leaders.
  • Thought Leadership: Challenges conventional thinking and sparks meaningful analytical debate with peers and executives.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative discipline required; Master’s or PhD in a quantitative field strongly preferred.

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, or applied science (or 6+ years with a PhD), with a track record of delivering production-quality models that drove measurable business impact.
  • Demonstrated experience setting technical direction for a portfolio of AI/ML solutions and influencing decisions of senior business leaders.
  • Experience building personalization, recommendation, decision-optimization, or marketing-science solutions, in any industry.
  • Deep hands-on expertise in causal inference and experimentation, including A/B testing and quasi-experimental methods, to measure business impact.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience using generative AI and AI-assisted development tools (e.g., LLM APIs, AI coding assistants, agent frameworks) to prototype and deliver solutions, with concrete examples that can be walked through during the interview process.
  • Expert proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) and distributed data processing.
  • Experience productionizing AI/ML solutions in cloud environments, including deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
  • Track record of leading initiatives across complex, cross-functional stakeholder environments and presenting to executive audiences.

Preferred Experience

  • Commercial analytics experience in pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, or life sciences, including familiarity with data sources such as IQVIA, Symphony Health, APLD, or similar Rx, claims, and engagement data.
  • Experience in omnichannel analytics, such as journey analysis, touchpoint measurement, closed-loop measurement, or next-best-action for HCP or patient engagement.
  • Experience with advanced ML and optimization methods, including reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, transformers, and other approaches for sequential or recommendation use cases.
  • Experience building LLM-based and agentic AI systems, including orchestration frameworks, evaluation, and integration through APIs and pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud ML platforms and MLOps tools such as Azure ML, Databricks, and MLflow.
  • External visibility through conference talks, publications, patents, open-source contributions, or recognized industry thought leadership.
  • Experience working in agile product development environments.

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Overview


The Professional Services Category Manager is responsible for leading Agilent’s global sourcing strategy, supplier management, and commercial governance for Professional Services and Finance categories. The portfolio includes management consulting, financial and audit consulting, key strategic transformation initiatives, outsourced services, engineering and technical services, research and development support, clinical and laboratory services, and other specialized project resources.


Operating within Global Indirect Procurement and the Corporate Services team, this role partners with senior leaders across the enterprise, including Corporate Development, the Transformation Office, Finance, Global Supply, R&D, and other corporate functions, to optimize cost, improve supplier performance, mitigate risk, and enable enterprise priorities.


The role leads highly visible, complex sourcing initiatives; shapes category direction; influences executive stakeholders across regions; and serves as a procurement subject-matter expert. Success requires exceptional influencing skills, strong stakeholder management, advanced negotiation skills, and a proven ability to deliver results.


Key Responsibilities


Global Category Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and execute multi-year global category strategies aligned with Agilent’s business priorities, financial objectives, and transformation agenda.
  • Develop and lead Agilent's preferred supplier strategy for professional services, including supplier segmentation, governance, performance management, and adoption across business functions.
  • Create category playbooks based on spend, supplier concentration, demand patterns, contract coverage, market dynamics, business risk, and stakeholder requirements.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities for competitive sourcing, supplier consolidation, standardization, demand management, and commercial model optimization.
  • Build and maintain a forward-looking pipeline of sourcing events, renewals, and strategic supplier initiatives.

Business Partnership & Executive Influence

  • Serve as the primary procurement advisor for Professional Services, helping senior stakeholders select appropriate sourcing strategies, suppliers, engagement models, and commercial structures.
  • Influence stakeholders to increase competitive tension, use preferred suppliers, aggregate demand, improve requirements, and adopt enterprise category strategies.
  • Present sourcing recommendations, negotiation outcomes, business cases, risks, and decisions in clear executive-level terms.
  • Facilitate cross-functional and cross-regional alignment to maximize enterprise leverage while addressing critical business needs.

Strategic Sourcing & Negotiation

  • Lead complex global and regional sourcing initiatives, including strategy development, RFPs, RFQs, supplier evaluation, negotiation, recommendation, and implementation.
  • Negotiate best-in-class commercial arrangements, including fixed-fee, milestone-based, outcome-based, managed-service, retainer, rate-card, and time-and-material models.
  • Develop fact-based negotiation strategies that balance cost, quality, flexibility, speed, innovation, and risk.

Supplier Relationship & Performance Management

  • Establish governance frameworks for strategic Professional Services suppliers, including roles, decision rights, escalation paths, KPIs, and executive review cadence.
  • Lead supplier business reviews and performance discussions focused on service quality, commercial compliance, measurable outcomes, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Implement scorecards and corrective action plans and hold suppliers accountable for contractual and operational commitments.
  • Monitor supplier, concentration, financial, operational, data, and reputational risks and coordinate mitigation plans.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, category management, or a consulting background.
  • Demonstrated experience managing Professional Services, consulting, outsourcing, or other complex indirect service categories.
  • Proven success leading high-value sourcing initiatives and complex commercial negotiations in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Strong stakeholder-influencing, analytical, negotiation, and executive communication capabilities.
  • Ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and drive decisions without direct authority.

Preferred

  • Master’s degree, MBA, CPSM, CIPS, CPM, or an equivalent professional qualification.
  • Experience in life sciences, diagnostics, technology, or another highly regulated global industry.
  • Experience implementing preferred supplier programs, managed services, or supplier performance programs.
  • Experience with eSourcing, spend analytics, procurement reporting, and contract lifecycle management platforms.

Additional Details

jobs.excerpt: Real people.  Real service. At SupplyHouse. com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first.
jobs.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Content Strategist to join our Growth Marketing Team in our Marketing department. This individual will report into our SEO Manager and own the content strategy, direction, and quality across SupplyHouse’s blog, SEO landing pages, and product detail pages (PDPs), with a focus on driving organic search growth, increasing visibility across AI-powered search platforms, and maintaining a consistent, authentic brand voice. Working closely with our Director of Growth Marketing and partners across SEO, Brand, and Product/Merchandising, this role will establish editorial standards, guide content priorities, and develop strategies that strengthen our digital presence and contribute to customer acquisition goals. If you’re passionate about creating impactful content, enjoy combining creativity with data-driven strategy, and are excited to explore new opportunities in SEO and AI-powered search, we’d love to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

Base Salary: The expected starting salary for the position is $77,009 to $96,261 within a full position range of $77,009 to $115,514 annually. This range reflects the long-term earning potential for the role. Our starting pay practice is the minimum to middle portion of the range, depending on experience, qualifications, and internal equity, consistent with applicable law and it is rare for a new hire to start above the midpoint.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain a content roadmap across the blog, SEO landing pages, and PDPs that prioritizes topics by search demand, AI-citation potential, and revenue opportunity
  • Define and enforce content structure standards (headers, schema, answer-first formatting, comparison and FAQ blocks) that make content rankable in traditional search and citable by AI answer engines
  • Safeguard the SupplyHouse brand voice across all content, ensuring output (including AI-assisted drafts) reads as authentic, helpful, and consistent with brand guidelines
  • Review and edit AI-generated and human-written content for accuracy, tone, and duplication or cannibalization risk before publication
  • Write and edit original content, including blog features, brand storytelling, and PDP copy, where authenticity and voice matter most
  • Partner with the SEO and Growth Marketing team to translate keyword and topical-authority research into content briefs and production priorities
  • Monitor content performance across organic traffic, AI citation and visibility share, and conversion, and adjust content strategy accordingly
  • Partner with Product and Merchandising teams to ensure PDP content accurately reflects product data while remaining optimized for search and AI discovery
  • Track and adapt to evolving AI search behavior (LLM crawling, citation mechanics, answer engine optimization) to keep content practices current
  • Manage relationships with freelance writers or content vendors as needed to support production capacity without compromising brand voice

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related business field
  • 3+ years of Content Strategy, ideally in e-commerce
  • 2+ years experience writing and editing for SEO
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a demonstrated ability to adapt tone and voice to a brand style guide
  • Experience optimizing content for AI/LLM visibility

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 work from home stipend
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • $25 monthly Grubhub credit
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: !

Additional Details:

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. SupplyHouse.com will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ABNORMAL AI

Abnormal AI stops the attacks other tools miss by understanding the behavior of every identity inside an organization, not just matching known signatures. That approach started with email, where we protect more than 5,000 customers, including 30% of the Fortune 500. It's the same behavioral AI, built over eight years, that now powers our new AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. We're launching new products faster than at any point in our history, and this role sits right at the center of that expansion.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite. One Specialist sits in each sales pod, working alongside the pod's Account Executives to bring deep sales and product expertise to AI Security conversations. This is a sales role, built for someone who can carry a number and go as deep technically as our best engineers when a conversation demands it. If you want to be at the center of one of the fastest-moving new product lines in cybersecurity, with the technical range to earn trust at every level of a customer's organization, this is that role.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Carry a dedicated quota for the AI Security suite, separate from your pod's core quota.
  • Partner with Account Executives across your pod to identify, qualify, and advance AI Security opportunities within existing and prospective accounts.
  • Go deep on the technical substance of behavioral AI, cloud security, and agent security when customers need more than a standard pitch, credibly holding your own with security and platform teams.
  • Run point on design partner conversations for products still in early availability, partnering closely with product leadership to shape these deals and bring the right resources to the table.
  • Help build the playbook for how AI Security gets sold as this suite matures from early availability into GA. Much of this motion is still being defined, and you'll have real influence over how it takes shape.
  • Stay current as the suite evolves. Availability and depth will shift quickly as products move from design partner to GA.

WHAT YOU'LL SELL

Abnormal's AI Security suite includes five products, each at a different stage of availability:

Product

Description

AI Governance

Discovers your AI, uncovers shadow AI, and shows who's using what and at what cost.

AI Cloud Security

Detects and contains AI cloud breaches using behavioral AI and honeypots.

AI Employee Guardrails

Lets employees use AI without leaking data or triggering unintended actions.

AI Agent Security

Inventories an organization's AI agents and ensures they behave as intended.

AI Security Workbench

Lets security teams use AI to run investigations with Abnormal's models, without guardrails.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS RIGHT NOW

AI security is coming up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust Abnormal's behavioral approach to solve it. Every security vendor is staking a claim in this space, but Abnormal has earned real credibility here through eight years of behavioral AI investment and a proven track record protecting email for thousands of customers.

That trust is an advantage today, not a permanent one, and this role exists to make sure Abnormal capitalizes on it while the window is open. For the right person, that means getting in early on a brand-new motion, working closely with executive and product leadership, and building a track record as one of the people who defined how this category gets sold.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years of Enterprise sales experience (3,000+ seat accounts), with a proven track record of winning new logos, expanding accounts, and displacing legacy competitors in competitive markets.
  • Genuine technical depth and curiosity: comfort discussing AI architecture, cloud security concepts, and how behavioral models work, in enough detail to earn trust with technical buyers.
  • Ability to operate in ambiguity. This suite and the motion for selling it are both still evolving, and much of the playbook will be built by whoever takes this role on.
  • Strong cross-functional instincts. This role depends on tight partnership with AEs, Sales Engineering, and product leadership rather than working in isolation.
  • Prior exposure to cybersecurity, AI/ML concepts, or cloud security.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution!
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is at the forefront of the generative AI revolution! The Algorithmic Model Optimization Team focuses on optimizing generative AI models such as large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), and diffusion models for maximal inference efficiency using techniques ranging from quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning to neural architecture search, and automated deployment strategies.

Our work includes conducting applied research to improve model efficiency as well as developing an innovative open-source model optimization platform (NVIDIA Model Optimizer). Our software is used both internally across NVIDIA and externally by research and engineering teams alike developing best-in-class AI models.

We are seeking a GenAI Algorithms Intern to help optimize state-of-the-art generative AI models like LLMs, VLMs, multimodal and diffusion models. In this role, you will design, implement, and productionize model optimization algorithms for inference and deployment on NVIDIA’s latest hardware platforms. The focus is on ease of use, compute and memory efficiency, and achieving the best accuracy–performance tradeoffs through software–hardware co-design.

Your work will span multiple layers of the AI software stack—ranging from algorithm design to integration—within NVIDIA’s ecosystem (Model Optimizer, NeMo/Megatron, TensorRT-LLM) and open-source frameworks (PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, SGLang). You may also dive deeper into GPU-level optimization, including custom kernel development with CUDA and Triton.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Help design and build modular, scalable model optimization software platforms that deliver exceptional user experiences while supporting diverse AI models and optimization techniques.
  • Explore, develop, and integrate innovative deep learning optimization algorithms (quantization, speculative decoding, sparsity, distillation, pruning, neural architecture search) into NVIDIA's AI software stack.
  • Deploy optimized models into leading open-source inference frameworks and contribute specialized APIs, model-level optimizations, and new features tailored to the latest NVIDIA hardware capabilities.
  • Collaborate with NVIDIA teams on model optimization solutions for customer use cases, aiming for optimal end-to-end workflows and balanced accuracy–performance trade-offs.
  • Conduct GPU kernel-level profiling to identify and capitalize on hardware and software optimization opportunities (e.g., efficient attention kernels, KV cache optimization, parallelism strategies).

What we need to see:

  • Pursuing a Master's or PhD in Computer Science, AI, Applied Math, or a related field.
  • Strong deep learning background and hands-on experience with language models.
  • Solid foundation in algorithms and programming.
  • Proficiency in Python, PyTorch, and modern ML frameworks/tools.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with model optimization and efficiency (e.g., quantization, distillation, pruning).
  • Contributions to PyTorch, JAX, vLLM, SGLang, or other machine learning training and inference frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning generative AI models on large-scale GPU clusters.
  • Knowledge of GPU architectures and compilation stacks, and the ability to analyze and debug end-to-end performance.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA’s deep learning SDKs (Model Optimizer, NeMo).

Increasingly known as “the AI computing company” and widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. Are you creative, motivated, and love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you! Come, join our model optimization group, where you can help build real-time, cost-effective computing platforms driving our success in this exciting and rapidly-growing field.

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Senior Software Engineer - Security Assurances

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance to join our GRC engineering team. We are building a security system that’s automated at scale, rigorously data-driven, and built from the ground up with defense-in-depth and self-healing in mind. We support a highly autonomous, remote-first, cloud-native organization. We are a technical team that can build any tool we need, while knowing when to buy to improve velocity.

To support our growth and ambitious vision, we embrace agile principles and values, share openly, apply context-driven security mechanisms, default to action, and have an OSS-first mindset. The Opportunity:

You will work to build out our security observability, compliance, and control management systems and tools. You will develop services and tools to proactively defend our systems, provide visibility to our security state, and give engineers and stakeholders guardrails and paved roads to behave securely. You will collaborate across your team, the security department, and wider Grafana to write and deploy security policies across all of our SDLC, applications, and infrastructure.

This is a very technical, hands-on keyboard software engineering, so development experience is critical. You will ideally have some experience building, implementing and improving the maturity of security programs in Cloud-based SaaS organizations. Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO, FedRAMP, PCI-DSS, GDPR, etc) is useful, but the disposition to quickly learn new things is more important than rote knowledge. You will work alongside other security engineers, full-stack developers, and customer-facing teams. Experience guiding and negotiating with peers, stakeholders, customers, and auditors is a plus.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Be a technical contributor on our GRC team covering a range of areas, including certifications, application, build, cloud, and supply chain security, and internal security tooling development
  • Develop, implement, and maintain highly automated security assurance programs to ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, NIST, PCI-DSS, TISAX, whatever else our customers eventually throw at us)
  • Develop systems, automations, and methods of security observability to push the GRC engineering organization beyond just meeting certification requirements
  • Deploy security and compliance checks in an employee-enabling way (guardrails and paved roads) in their daily workflows and build pipelines
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate security controls into the software development lifecycle and operational processes.
  • Respond to customer security issues, security alerts, and potential incidents

What Makes You a Great Fit:

  • Experience developing in a production environment with at least one programming language. We primarily use Go, TypeScript, and Python but most languages translate well. You will take a code screen and be expected to discuss programming principles such as algorithms, data structures, and optimization
  • Knowledge of using and securing containerized, cloud-native applications, ideally with Kubernetes. Experience with multiple cloud providers is a strong plus
  • Experience in automating security and compliance processes using tools, scripts, and frameworks while enabling developer and employee workflows
  • Strong interpersonal skills, as this position will require communication with peers, stakeholders, auditors, and customers
  • Understanding of industry-recognized security frameworks, standards, and certifications, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, NIST, or GDPR, and how to apply them without added operational burden. You can gain this by reading the standards documents and audit guidance
  • A degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience)

Bonus Points For:

  • Working knowledge of Grafana Labs OSS projects and products. Experience in using observability tooling to solve security problems.
  • Experience working with OSS communities
  • Experience in using technical automations to prove infrastructure compliance
  • Experience securing large-scale distributed systems running in public clouds

We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.

jobs.description:
Twin Health

At Twin Health, we empower people to improve and prevent chronic metabolic diseases, like type 2 diabetes and obesity, with a new standard of care. Twin Health is the only company applying AI Digital Twin technology exclusively toward metabolic health.

We start by building a dynamic model of each person’s metabolism — drawing on thousands of data points from CGMs, smartwatches, and meal logs — that maps their personal path to better health. Guided by a dedicated clinical care team, our members have lowered their A1C below the diabetes range, achieved lasting weight loss, and reduced or even eliminated medications, all while living healthier, happier lives.

Working here

Our team at Twin Health is passionate, talented, and united by a shared purpose: to improve the metabolic health and happiness of our members. We believe in empowering every Twin to make a meaningful impact for our members, our clients, and each other, while enjoying a supportive, collaborative work environment.

Twin has been recognized not only for our innovation but also for our culture, including: Innovator of the Year by the Employer Health Innovation Roundtable (EHIR), selected to CB Insights’ Digital Health 150, and named one of Newsweek’s Top Most Loved Workplace® .

With more than $100 million raised in recent funding, including a $53 million Series E round in 2025 led by Maj Invest, and a $50 million investment in 2023 led by Temasek, Twin is scaling rapidly across the U.S. and globally. Backed by leading venture firms like ICONIQ Growth, Sequoia, Sofina, Temasek, and Peak XV, we are building the most impactful digital health company in the world.

Join us as we reinvent the standard of care in metabolic health.

Opportunity

In this pivotal role, you’ll take the lead on the member-facing programs that introduce people to our life-changing care. Your top priority will be architecting the end-to-end service journey—from the moment a member is introduced to our offering through their complete onboarding. You will act as a strategic visionary in a fast-moving environment, mapping out complex enrollment flows and translating them into highly engaging experiences that inspire program adoption by clearly demonstrating the transformative benefits of our care.

Twin HQ is in Menlo Park, California, but this role is open to remote applicants in the US.

We are seeking a designer whose exceptional visual craft is matched only by their deep, rigorous service design thinking. You are a strategic systems-builder who brings order to ambiguity. You aren't just designing screens; you are designing holistic, deeply considered omnichannel experiences that balance premium, persuasive aesthetics with the logistical complexities of physical hardware and digital healthcare.

Responsibilities

  • Define Personas & Value Propositions: Identify and construct distinct user personas based on direct research insights. Uncover the specific barriers and core value propositions that resonate most powerfully with each persona, ensuring we speak directly to their unique needs.
  • Architect Persona-Driven Journeys: Take the lead on multiple programs by mapping out tailored end-to-end enrollment flows. Design targeted experiences centered around the established value propositions of your personas to create a seamless, persuasive transition from initial program discovery to active participation.
  • Drive Comprehensive Service Design: Look beyond isolated digital features to own the entire physical and digital ecosystem. Design interconnected touchpoints that guide members through tracking their health kit shipment, the physical unboxing experience, pairing their hardware sensors, and scheduling their initial virtual appointment with the Twin Health care team.
  • Craft Compelling, Premium Visuals: Produce immaculate websites, landing pages, and enrollment assets that excite members and clearly communicate our value. High visual polish is critical to building trust, and you must balance this premium consumer-facing aesthetic with rapid execution.
  • Navigate Cross-Functional Complexity: Operate effectively in high-velocity, ambiguous environments. Collaborate closely with marketing, hardware/logistics, and clinical operations to ensure the physical realities of unboxing and hardware setup align perfectly with the digital UX.
  • Influence Without Authority: Drive a cohesive, user-first mindset across product, engineering, and client-facing teams. Clearly articulate your research-backed design rationale and align disparate groups around a shared vision for an unparalleled onboarding experience.
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Service & Visual Design Mastery: 8+ years of UX/product design experience. Your portfolio must be a masterclass in both high-end visual polish (consumer-facing or marketing-led design) and complex, multi-touchpoint journey mapping, showcasing how you connect digital and physical interactions.
  • Research & Strategy Expertise: Proven experience conducting user research, defining actionable personas, and successfully translating those strategic insights into tailored, high-converting product flows.
  • Domain Expertise: Proven experience designing complex consumer enrollment flows, digital healthcare journeys, or premium e-commerce/unboxing experiences. You understand how to use design to drive adoption and build user habits from day one.
  • Omnichannel Agility: Deep expertise spanning responsive web and native mobile design patterns. You confidently navigate the constraints of different platforms and know how to bridge the gap between UI flows and real-world actions (like connecting Bluetooth sensors).
  • Systems & Logistics Literacy: Experience designing for hardware-software integrations or complex logistical workflows (e.g., shipping tracking, appointment routing) is a distinct advantage. You can communicate clearly with engineering regarding technical capabilities and data flows.
  • Communication: Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. You can pitch a concept, defend a complex product decision, and write the persuasive, engaging UI copy needed to speak to different personas, drive enrollment, and reduce drop-off.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in design, service design, HCI, or a related field.
  • This remote opportunity based out of the U.S. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S.

Compensation and Benefits

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.

  • Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.

Safety Critical Aviation Systems

  • Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.

  • Direct professional experience using SCADE.
  • Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.
  • Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.
  • Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.
  • Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.
  • Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.
  • Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.
