We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.
That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.
We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Role:

Fullscript is how thousands of healthcare providers deliver better care to their patients, and paid digital is one of our biggest growth levers. As Senior Digital Marketing Specialist, you’ll oversee paid strategy across search, social, and programmatic, manage a large budget, and have a dedicated experimentation budget to find the channels and tactics that will drive our next stage of growth. You’ll work with a high-performing agency and a small in-house team, with the autonomy to shape how Fullscript reaches new providers online.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven and strategic marketing leader who can balance hands-on campaign management with long-term strategic vision. You will shape Fullscript’s paid digital approach, mentor a growing team, and continuously evolve how Fullscript connects with healthcare providers online.

What You’ll Do:

  • Paid Digital Strategy: Includes Paid Search, including Google’s AI-driven formats (PMax, AI Max) and automated bidding, with the judgment to know when to lean into automation and when to take back control. Social, and Programmatic.Strategically drive planning, executing, and optimizing paid campaigns across platforms, focusing on customer acquisition. Ensure cohesive strategy across all channels.

  • Campaign Management: While hands-on execution is managed by our agency, this role will be expected to optimize, and troubleshoot digital campaigns across the marketing funnel. Leverage market-leading DSPs, Meta, Google Ads, and Microsoft Ads to achieve Fullscript’s growth goals.

  • Test & Learn: Own a dedicated experimentation budget to pilot new channels, tactics, and formats, such as healthcare networks, CTV, LinkedIn, or emerging AI-driven ad products. Design tests with clear hypotheses and success criteria, and make the call on what scales and what gets cut.

  • Data Analysis & Insights: Own how we measure paid performance, using incrementality testing, first-party data, and offline conversion tracking to optimize toward qualified providers and revenue, not just leads. Navigate signal loss and healthcare advertising restrictions, and turn large data sets into clear recommendations that drive efficiency and ROI.

  • Team Collaboration & Leadership: Work closely with internal teams including marketing, creative, and data, while also managing external partners. Provide mentorship and guidance to junior team members, ensuring the effective execution of campaigns.

  • Client & Partner Relationships: Develop and maintain strong relationships with external partners, and cross functional stakeholders. Collaborate on strategy and planning for campaigns as part of Fullscript’s broader marketing mix.

  • Process Improvement: Actively contribute to the development and enhancement of Fullscript’s paid digital capabilities, using AI tools and automation to speed up reporting, analysis, and creative iteration. Identify and implement process improvements to automate and streamline workflow to ensure efficient high-quality campaign delivery.

  • Budget Management: Oversee your portion of the paid digital budget management, including spend delivery, invoicing, investment, and forecast tracking. Help drive profitability within the department while ensuring campaign efficiency and performance.

What You’ll Bring:

  • 7+ years experience in paid digital campaign management, with hands-on experience using Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, DSPs, and other ad-serving platforms.

  • Experience in managing $5 million+ in annual paid budgets.

  • Strong knowledge of the digital advertising ecosystem, focused on the US and Canadian Healthcare market, with an emphasis on paid search, paid social, programmatic display, and their roles in customer engagement.

  • A sharp eye for performance copy, with experience writing and testing ad messaging that drives clicks and conversions.

  • Advanced proficiency in Google Sheets and Slides to be able to turn complex performance data into a clear story and recommendations for leadership.

  • Exceptional analytical skills with the ability to work with large data sets and derive actionable insights.

  • Detail-oriented with a high degree of numeracy and literacy to manage complex campaigns and deliver results.

  • Strong communication skills, able to work cross-functionally, and build relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

  • Experience managing commercial aspects of digital campaigns, including budgeting, invoicing, and margin management.

    • Bonus Points:

  • Healthcare B2B and B2C experience.

  • Experience and frameworks to apply with A/B testing to refine campaigns and improve results.

  • Familiarity with performance tracking tools like Google Analytics and Looker Studio to evaluate paid digital program performance.

  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies for a multi-product platform serving both SMB and Enterprise customers

Compensation Range:

    The salary range for this role is between $90 000 and $120 000 [CAD]. Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

    Final base salary depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

    Additionally:

    ⬦ Flexible PTO & competitive pay – Because work-life balance matters.
    ⬦ RRSP/401k match – Invest in your future.
    ⬦ Premium benefits package – Customizable coverage, paramedical services, and HSA.
    ⬦ Fullscript discounts – Save on high-quality wellness products.
    ⬦ Continuous learning opportunities – Training budgets and company-wide initiatives.
    ⬦ Hybrid & remote work flexibility – Your office, your way.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.
Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .
All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.
We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

  • Support root cause analysis and corrective action for test failures and escaped defects.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to brief anomalies and status to program leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with harness/wiring test methods (continuity, isolation, dielectric withstand).

  • Familiarity with quality management systems (AS9100, IATF 16949, ISO 9001) and production quality metrics.

Was uns besonders wichtig ist

  • Aufmerksam zuhört und die richtigen Fragen stellt

Unser Vergütungsmodell

Bewirb dich bei uns

jobs.excerpt: About the companyAt Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.
jobs.description:
About the company

At Covera Health, we're on a mission to improve healthcare by making every diagnosis more accurate.

Every year, millions of patients receive imaging that shapes life changing medical decisions. Yet too often, important findings are missed, patients struggle to access high quality imaging, and the healthcare system treats radiology like a commodity instead of one of the most critical moments in a patient's care journey.

We're changing that.

Covera combines clinical expertise, advanced AI, and one of the industry's largest radiology quality datasets to help detect disease earlier, improve diagnostic accuracy, and give clinicians greater confidence in every decision they make. Better diagnoses lead to better treatment, fewer unnecessary procedures, lower healthcare costs, and, most importantly, better outcomes for patients.

In 2026, Covera and Medmo came together to create the first platform designed to support the entire radiology journey. From helping patients find and schedule high quality imaging, to coordinating care, to ensuring the accuracy of every diagnosis, we're building a connected experience that simply hasn't existed before.

Backed by Insight Partners, our platform supports nearly 6 million people across Fortune 10 and Fortune 100 employers, three of the five largest national health plans, and thousands of value based primary care physicians.

This is an exciting moment to join Covera. We're building technology that is helping detect serious conditions earlier, improving the quality of care for millions of patients, and redefining what healthcare can be. If you're excited by meaningful work, ambitious teammates, and the opportunity to help save lives through better healthcare, we'd love to meet you.

About the role

Covera's Population Health program is scaling rapidly across multiple states and a growing roster of national and regional health plan and provider clients. Each client needs a clear, credible performance story: what the program found, what closed, what it was worth, and where it should grow next. The Manager, Growth and Reporting owns that story, turning the program's analytics into client-facing reporting, performance-review materials, and expansion business cases that drive retention and wallet-share growth.

The seam is deliberate: Performance Analytics produces the numbers; this role turns numbers into insight and growth; Customer Engagement runs the client relationship rhythm. You are the bridge between what the data says and what the client decides to do next.

This role will initially report to the Chief Financial & Operations Officer before transitioning to the VP, Population Health as that leader joins the organization. This reporting structure is intentional and reflects the long-term design of the team.

In this role, you will be expected to:

  • Own client performance reporting: the recurring reporting packages and performance-review materials for every client, built on the Performance Analytics function's data.
  • Own the performance narrative: translating gap identification, closure results, and program value into materials a health plan or provider executive acts on, with disciplined distinctions the client can trust; submitted is not closed, and immature cohorts are labeled as such.
  • Make reporting actionable at the practice level: which practices are converting, which need intervention, and what happens next, built with the analytics and clinical functions, so every performance review ends in an action, not just a summary.
  • Support growth: identify and build the case for wallet-share expansion with existing clients, including additional services, pathologies, and populations, with supporting materials.
  • Work with Covera's clinical team to understand the clinical and economic pathway for each pathology the program surfaces, what appropriate care looks like and what it is worth, grounded in claims analysis or credible third-party studies, and build that understanding into client materials so growth conversations carry clinical and economic weight.
  • Build a consistent, scalable reporting framework, including a stage-level funnel view from finding to closure, that holds up as the book grows, rather than bespoke decks per client, and uphold the standard that no definitive claims about a partner's results or future direction appear in external materials without that partner's approval.
  • In your first 90 days: take over the live reporting calendar without a gap in cadence, ship the standard reporting package, stand up reporting for newly onboarding clients, and deliver the first expansion business case with program leadership.

Requirements:

  • Experience turning healthcare performance data into executive-facing narratives: client success, consulting, health plan account management, or program reporting backgrounds all fit.
  • Working familiarity with the reports behind the story: claims-based analysis, eligibility data, and Medicare reporting such as MAO-004 or CDI, enough to understand what the data means, pressure-test it, and articulate the actionable insight, even though producing it belongs to the analytics function.
  • Comfort building pathology-level value narratives: the clinical pathway, the economics of appropriate care, and the evidence base behind both, developed in partnership with clinical experts.
  • Strong materials craft: you build clear, credible decks and documents quickly, and know the difference between reporting data and telling a client what it means.
  • Commercial instinct: you spot the expansion opportunity inside a performance review and can build the case for it.
  • Hypothesis-driven by habit: you ask the relevant questions, form a view, test it, verify the result, and repeat. We will ask what you built, what changed as a result, and what failed.
  • Fluency with value-based care and Medicare programs sufficient to hold the room with plan and provider stakeholders.
  • Collaborative by structure: this role succeeds through tight seams with analytics, customer engagement, and clinical partners.

AI at Covera

At Covera Health, AI is not a novelty. It's a core part of how we work. Every team member is expected to actively use AI in their day-to-day role, and we invest in building that fluency across the organization. If you lean into new tools and are energized by what's still possible, you'll fit in.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical plans - choose from three plans, including one with 100% of premiums covered for you and your dependents
  • Vision & Dental
  • Hybrid Time Off Policy (Flexible Time Off (FTO) Policy for exempt employees and Paid Time Off (PTO) Policy for non-exempt employees)
  • Sick days in accordance with your state law
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 12 Fixed Holidays (company closed)
  • 5 Covera Days
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Annual Professional Development Stipend to invest in courses, books, or any other professional development related activity
  • Annual Wellness stipend for fitness, mental health or other wellness expenses

The minimum and maximum base salary for this position ranges from $130,000 to $160,000, in addition to a discretionary bonus and comprehensive benefits package. Final compensation will be based on a number of factors including but not limited to, a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, experience, expertise and location.

Please note

We may use automated tools and/or AI to assist in reviewing applications.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. Equal Opportunity is the Law, and Covera Health is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. jobs.description:
About Project Healthy Minds

Project Healthy Minds is a mental health nonprofit that runs like a tech startup. We are pioneering a first-of-its-kind model: applying technology to address one of the biggest social issues of our time: the growing mental health crisis. We believe in a simple but profound idea: that it should be as easy to find mental health services as it is to book a flight or a restaurant reservation. That's why we're building the world’s first digital marketplace for finding mental health services that are right for you.

To do that, we work with some of the most inspiring and influential leaders in America - business titans, tech entrepreneurs, clinicians and scientists, musicians, artists, athletes, media stars, policymakers, and more - because we believe that the world's most complex challenges require interdisciplinary teams and solutions.

We are backed by a powerhouse of industry-leading Board of Directors and Advisory Council Members who are passionate, hands-on, and dive into the important work with us.

Learn more at and @projecthealthyminds on social.

About The Engagement

  • Based in the US (ideally LA)
  • ~20 hours a week, set with the Services Research Manager.
  • Initial 90-day contract, with the option to extend as we add locations.

About The Role

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

People come to Project Healthy Minds to find mental health services they can trust. We're growing – going beyond national services and building local listings. Each listing has to get the details right: the address, the hours, who the service is for, expectations around costs, and whether the service meets the screening criteria our Clinical Advisory Committee (CAC) sets for that type of service. You'll do the research behind those listings, working with our Services Research Manager to grow our services directory.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Verify and complete service records: address, hours, contact details, costs, insurance, and other tags in our data model.
  • Label services against our screening criteria, quoting the evidence for each answer.
  • Find services we don't list yet as we build each new location.
  • Note any service that doesn't fit our data model and explain what doesn't fit.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • You've done research where accuracy mattered and you had to cite your sources, such as at a 211 or resource directory, in fact-checking, on a civic data team, or in a library.
  • You're comfortable contacting organizations you don't know and getting clear answers from whoever responds.
  • You follow a written procedure closely, and you speak up when it doesn't fit what you're finding.
  • You're organized in spreadsheets and careful with details.
  • You're comfortable with AI tools and check their output before you trust it.
  • You care about the person on the other end: someone looking for help, often on a hard day, who can't afford a wrong phone number or a clinic that closed last year.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Spanish or another language besides English.

jobs.description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?
If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.
At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.

ORGANIZATION SUMMARY

World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.
Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:

World Relief seeks a manager to lead its growing Donations Management Team. This role is accountable for the timely, accurate, secure, and donor-centered processing of charitable contributions across giving channels. This role establishes operational standards, supervises staff, owns policies and controls, collaborates with Advancement, Finance, IT, and other partners, and ensures donation records, receipting, fund coding, reconciliation, and donor service are completed with integrity.

The Manager serves as the primary escalation point for complex gift-processing issues and ensures the function remains aligned with organizational priorities, accepted nonprofit gift-administration practices, and audit-ready documentation. As World Relief continues to expand, it is vital that this role is someone who can also have a vision for the future of how we can provide world class donations management services.
100% Remote, bi-annual 4-day in-person event attendance expected

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • This role is responsible for supervising others and includes responsibilities consistent with supervising employees, including but not limited to monitoring daily work activities, tracking and approving timesheets including approving time off, monitoring performance including entering goals, progress check-ins, and weekly or bi-weekly check-ins, documenting performance concerns, entering staff promotions, transitions, and separations in HRIS within required time frame. Managers at World Relief are also considered spiritual leaders and are expected to lead staff in a manner consistent with our Christian values, including but not limited to praying with staff, leading devotionals, and fostering a Christian environment in interactions with staff throughout World Relief.
  • Supervise Donations Management staff, including work planning, regular check-ins, goals, performance management, time and leave approvals, training, professional development, and required HRIS actions. Act as a spiritual leader who fosters a Christian work environment consistent with World Relief's values.
  • Set team priorities, service standards, staffing coverage, and quality expectations to ensure timely gift processing, tax receipting, donor notifications, and fundraiser alerts, including during peak campaigns and events.
  • Own the creation, approval, maintenance, and periodic review of Donations Management policies, controls, and standard operating procedures, including gift entry and coding, receipting, fund and event setup, refunds, recurring gifts, failed or returned transactions, anonymous gifts, gift credit, fundraiser notifications, documentation retention, and exception handling.
  • Oversee end-to-end processing and quality for checks, ACH and wires, credit and debit card gifts, recurring gifts, stock, cryptocurrency, workplace and payroll giving, donor-advised or third-party gifts, event platforms, and other current or emerging donation channels.
  • Ensure donor and gift records are consistently and accurately coded in Raiser's Edge and connected platforms, and ensure Fund IDs and related accounting codes align with general ledger requirements.
  • Direct recurring quality assurance, platform audits, exception review, and corrective-action follow-up; identify root causes and remove operational barriers that affect processing speed, accuracy, donor experience, or financial reporting.
  • Oversee donor service and escalations involving declined transactions, recurring gift changes, address and communication preference updates, receipts, refunds, returns, and other donation questions.
  • Oversee monthly reconciliations for online credit card, direct debit, and other giving streams; review pull-through submissions and fund summary reporting; partner with Finance to resolve variances and maintain audit-ready support.
  • Coordinate with the Raiser's Edge Database Administrator and other system owners on fiscal-year readiness, year-end tax statements, fund maintenance, access, integrations, and system or process changes affecting donations.
  • Build productive cross-functional relationships with Advancement, Finance, front-office/mail processing, Technology, fundraising teams, vendors, and distributed processing partners; clarify ownership, handoffs, service expectations, and escalation paths.
  • Prepare and manage the team budget, vendor and facility needs, and operational planning; visit the donation-processing facility at least annually or as business needs require.
  • Define and monitor meaningful operational measures such as turnaround time, accuracy, exceptions, unresolved items, and donor-service responsiveness; use trends to prioritize training and continuous improvement.
  • Maintain current knowledge of charitable gift administration and data stewardship practices, recommend improvements, and ensure appropriate confidentiality and safeguarding of donor and payment information.
  • Serve as the final operational decision-maker and escalation point for complex, unusual, or high-risk gifts within delegated authority, and elevate legal, tax, compliance, cybersecurity, reputational, or donor-intent concerns to the appropriate organizational owner.
  • Oversee and execute special projects as assigned

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

  • Mature and personal Christian faith
  • Committed to the mission, vision, and values of World Relief
  • Desire to serve and empower the Church to impact vulnerable communities
  • Able to affirm and/or acknowledge World Reliefs Core Beliefs, Statement of Faith, Christian Identity and National Association of Evangelicals' For the Health of The Nation document
  • Valid drivers license, access to reliable vehicle and ability to pass MVR standards
  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent combination of education and progressively responsible experience.
  • Strong understanding of gift coding, donor intent, receipting, reconciliations, data quality, internal controls, documentation, and confidentiality.
  • Previous people-management or formal supervisory experience.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Five or more years of relevant gift-processing, advancement-services, donor-services, or financial-operations experience, including two or more years leading staff or a significant operational function.
  • Experience supporting a large, multi-entity, multi-location, or international nonprofit organization.
  • Experience with charitable gifts such as stock, cryptocurrency, workplace giving, donor-advised funds, matching gifts, and event-based giving.
  • Experience with financial audits, payment-card controls, CRM integrations, process mapping, and continuous-improvement methods.
  • Relevant professional development or certification in fundraising operations, advancement services, nonprofit accounting, data management, or project management.
  • Working knowledge of Raiser's Edge NXT or a comparable fundraising CRM and familiarity with online fundraising and payment platforms.
  • Advanced ability to analyze operational issues, exercise sound judgment, manage risk, and translate findings into durable processes and controls.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, cross-functional leadership, change management, and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word, including the ability to review reconciliations, reports, and large data sets.
  • Ability to prioritize competing deadlines and lead the team through peak-volume periods with accuracy and composure.

jobs.description:
SENIOR DIRECTOR OF OPERATIONS

TH Experiential | Remote (US) | Full-time

TH Experiential is an experiential marketing and events agency with a 20-year history, building immersive brand worlds for global clients. We are in a growth stage, scaling the team and the business.

We are looking for a Senior Director of Operations to build and run how the agency operates day to day. This is a senior leadership role and a critical one for our next phase of growth.

You will build on the systems that make the agency run effectively, and you will get into the work to do it. You will work with each team, learn how the work moves, and build a standardized, repeatable way of operating that teams plug into, from intake and RFP through delivery and close-out. You lead through our team leads and program managers, set the standard, and hold the agency to it.

WHAT THIS ROLE OWNS

Operating framework and process

Own and evolve how TH runs across the full client and project lifecycle. Build the SOPs, workflows, and operating rhythms that make the work repeatable, and enforce them so projects are set up, scoped, staffed, and tracked the same way every time.

Project delivery

Own how projects are delivered across pitch, execution, close-out, and follow-up. Make sure every project is set up, run, and closed out the same way, so clients get clarity, consistency, and follow-through, and the team delivers on time and on margin.

Resourcing, capacity, and hours

Own hours forecasting and capacity planning across proposal, project, and support teams. Staff to the work in front of us, see what is coming, and plan ahead so we are always a step in front of the work.

Profitability and margin

Own project profitability, making sure every project is budgeted against real hours and costs, change orders are priced and signed before the work is done, and margins are tracked in real time. Find where we win and lose margin, and turn it into how we price and plan ahead.

Visibility and performance

Build the metrics, dashboards, and reporting that give leadership real-time visibility into project health, hours burn, margin, and operational risk, without having to go gather it. Surface risks early and drive corrective action.

Cadence and accountability

Own the weekly operating cadence across functions, feeding a clear picture of priorities, owners, and outcomes up to the leadership meeting. Keep the business running to its commitments, with gaps surfaced and resolved and the right issues raised for decision.

Developing our leads

Build the bench. Each lead works to clear expectations and a scorecard, with a regular rhythm of coaching that raises the standard of how they plan, own their areas, and bring forward solutions.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • Each team follows one clear, repeatable way of working
  • Projects are set up right, delivered on time, and closed out on margin, every time
  • Leadership has real-time visibility into performance, risk, capacity, and profitability
  • Resourcing is planned ahead of the work
  • Our leads run their areas against clear scorecards and bring forward solutions
  • The business runs on the system, so it scales without depending on any one person

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 8-10+ years in operations leadership in a deadline-driven, client-service business. Agency, production, events, or similar.
  • You have built operating systems and gotten teams to follow them. You know the difference between designing a process and making it work.
  • You get into the detail. You are as comfortable in the work as you are above it, and you would rather build the machine than diagram it.
  • You hold the line on standards. You address gaps directly and raise what needs leadership attention.
  • Strong at capacity and resource planning, project profitability, and building KPIs and scorecards tied to efficiency, profitability, and scale
  • You have developed managers into leaders, and you lead through others rather than carrying the work yourself
  • You can hold a standard across a distributed team
  • Clear, direct communicator who leads with follow-through
  • A plus if you have run or adapted a formal operating system such as EOS, including meeting cadence, scorecards, and accountability structures

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS

  • Base salary of $180,000 to $200,000, plus performance bonuses

- Health, dental, and life insurance

- 401(k) with company contribution

- Paid time off, sick days, and holidays

  • Remote work within the US, operating primarily on Eastern Time, with occasional travel as the work requires

TO APPLY

Send a resume and a short note on one operating system you built and got a team to actually follow. We would rather see one real example than a philosophy.

ABOUT THE ROLE

AI is rewriting how every company works, and everyone is racing to figure out how to secure it. We have, and we need someone to take it to market.

The AI Security Sales Executive is a quota-carrying sales role dedicated entirely to Abnormal's AI Security suite: five products built to help customers govern AI, secure AI, and defend against rogue AI. You will own AI Security in your territory, from the first conversation through close, hunting the largest new logos while working alongside the Account Executives who already know our customers best. The timing matters. Abnormal is growing about 50% year over year, with more than 5,000 customers and over 30% of the Fortune 500 trusting us to protect their people. AI security now comes up in close to 80% of customer conversations at the executive level, and customers already trust our behavioral AI to solve it. Demand is outrunning capacity. You will step into a deep pipeline on day one, and you will have real say in how this category gets sold.

Product

jobs.description:
We have an immediate opportunity for an IT Director to join a lean, high-impact technology team supporting more than 250 veterinary hospitals across the United States.

Reporting directly to the Vice President of Technology, the IT Director will be responsible for leading day-to-day IT service delivery and helping execute key technology initiatives across Alliance Animal Health.

This is a highly hands-on technical leadership position. While the IT Director will provide leadership, direction, vendor oversight, and project management, this individual will also remain actively engaged in the technology environment, including troubleshooting complex issues, Microsoft 365 administration, escalations, infrastructure support, and direct engagement with practice teams.

The IT Director will have primary responsibility for the success of AAH’s newly established co-managed IT support model, working closely with our managed service provider, internal technology resources, hospital teams, Operations leadership, and other business stakeholders. This individual will be accountable for ensuring practices receive a consistent, responsive, and high-quality support experience while maintaining transparency, measurable service standards, and a strong customer-focused culture.

In addition to service delivery, the IT Director will have an active role in executing strategic technology initiatives across the organization. Strong project management skills are essential, as this position will lead and coordinate technology deployments, infrastructure improvements, practice onboarding initiatives, security programs, vendor implementations, and other enterprise IT projects.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with service leadership, project management, business judgment, and an exceptional customer-service mindset. Experience supporting veterinary, animal health, or multi-site healthcare environments is strongly preferred.

This is a fully remote position with periodic travel required for hospital visits, vendor engagements, project implementations, leadership meetings, and strategic initiatives.

IT Support & Service Delivery

  • Own day-to-day IT support and service delivery across Alliance Animal Health’s national hospital network.
  • Provide leadership and direction for internal IT support resources and the co-managed IT service model.
  • Monitor ticket queues, escalations, service levels, response times, resolution performance, customer satisfaction, and recurring support trends.
  • Ensure practices receive consistent, timely, and customer-focused technology support.
  • Serve as a senior escalation resource and remain actively involved in troubleshooting complex technical issues when needed.
  • Establish and continuously improve support processes, escalation procedures, documentation standards, and service expectations.
  • Partner closely with hospital and Operations leadership to understand technology challenges and proactively address recurring issues.
  • Ensure technology support processes align with the operational needs of veterinary practices and minimize disruption to patient care and hospital operations.

Co-Managed IT & Vendor Management

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day operational leader for AAH’s co-managed IT partnership.
  • Manage the relationship with the organization’s managed service provider and ensure the partnership operates as an extension of the AAH Technology team.
  • Define and maintain clear responsibilities between internal IT resources and external technology partners.
  • Hold vendors accountable to contractual commitments, service-level expectations, reporting requirements, and customer satisfaction objectives.
  • Lead recurring service reviews and operational governance meetings.
  • Review ticket trends, escalations, after-hours activity, recurring incidents, service performance, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Coordinate onboarding, knowledge transfer, process improvement, and service expansion activities.
  • Work collaboratively with technology vendors supporting specialized systems and equipment within veterinary hospitals.

Customer Experience & Practice Support

  • Serve as a senior advocate for AAH hospitals and ensure technology services remain focused on the needs of practice teams.
  • Build strong relationships with Practice Managers, Regional Directors, Regional Managers, Operations leadership, and corporate stakeholders.
  • Maintain regular communication with business partners regarding service performance, technology initiatives, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Establish and maintain a culture of accountability, responsiveness, transparency, and exceptional customer service.
  • Monitor Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) and other experience metrics and develop improvement plans when performance falls below expectations.
  • Identify recurring issues across practices and work proactively with internal resources and external partners to address root causes.

Project & Program Management

  • Lead and coordinate key IT initiatives from planning through implementation and operational handoff.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, risks, and communication strategies.
  • Manage multiple concurrent technology projects across a nationally distributed organization.
  • Coordinate internal stakeholders, MSP resources, vendors, Operations teams, and hospital leadership throughout project execution.
  • Lead or support initiatives involving:
    • New hospital onboarding and integration
    • Network standardization and infrastructure modernization
    • End-of-life hardware replacement programs
    • Microsoft 365 initiatives
    • Cybersecurity improvements
    • Endpoint management and standardization
    • Application implementations and migrations
    • Vendor transitions
    • Technology policy and process improvements
  • Communicate project status, risks, decisions, dependencies, and outcomes clearly to Technology and business leadership.
  • Create repeatable deployment playbooks and standards that allow technology initiatives to scale across the organization.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Own IT operational reporting and develop meaningful performance insights for Technology and executive leadership.
  • Establish appropriate service delivery KPIs and ensure accurate, consistent reporting.
  • Create and distribute monthly, quarterly, and annual IT performance reports.
  • Monitor and report on:
    • Ticket volumes
    • First response times
    • Resolution times
    • Open and aging tickets
    • Escalation metrics
    • Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
    • After-hours support activity
    • Hospital support trends
    • MSP and vendor performance
    • Recurring incidents and problem areas
  • Use service data and trend analysis to identify operational improvements and technology investment opportunities.
  • Provide concise, actionable technology updates to senior leadership.

Technical Leadership

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of the AAH technology environment and remain actively involved in technical operations.
  • Serve as a senior technical escalation point for difficult or business-critical issues.
  • Troubleshoot issues involving endpoints, networking, Microsoft 365, authentication, cloud services, and hospital technology.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to Systems Administrators and other internal technology resources.
  • Work closely with MSP engineering teams on advanced infrastructure, network, security, and cloud issues.
  • Support technology standards covering workstations, servers, firewalls, switches, wireless infrastructure, remote access, endpoint security, and monitoring.
  • Partner with vendors supporting specialized veterinary equipment and software where coordination across multiple technology providers is required.
  • Maintain high-quality operational documentation, architecture information, asset visibility, standards, processes, and technology inventories.
  • Balance hands-on technical involvement with leadership responsibilities, escalating and delegating appropriately while maintaining ownership of outcomes.

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year institution in Information Technology, Information Systems, Information Technology Management, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive professional experience in IT support, systems administration, infrastructure, service delivery, or technical operations.
  • 3+ years of IT leadership, service delivery leadership, or technology team management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading IT operations within a multi-site or distributed organization.
  • Demonstrated experience managing an MSP, technology service provider, or co-managed IT relationship.
  • Strong project management experience with responsibility for planning and delivering technology initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and vendors.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 environments.

    • Microsoft Intune
    • Exchange Online
    • Microsoft Teams
    • SharePoint Online
    • Endpoint Management
    • Identity & Access Management
    • Conditional Access
    • Security and Compliance
  • Working knowledge of networking fundamentals and technologies, including firewalls, switches, wireless access points, VPNs, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity.
  • Experience with IT service management, ticketing systems, remote monitoring and management platforms, endpoint management, and remote support technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage service metrics, reporting, SLAs, escalations, and customer satisfaction programs.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the technical depth to participate directly in complex escalations when required.
  • Exceptional customer service, relationship management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with practice teams, technical resources, vendors, Operations leaders, and senior executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple priorities, projects, vendors, and operational responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to operate successfully within a fully remote organization and lead geographically distributed resources.
  • Ability to travel periodically as business and project requirements dictate.

Preferred

  • Veterinary or animal health technology experience is strongly preferred.
  • Experience supporting veterinary hospitals, animal health organizations, or other clinical environments.
  • Experience supporting 1,000+ users and/or 100+ geographically distributed locations.
  • Experience designing or operating a co-managed IT support model.
  • Experience leading technology integration for newly acquired or newly onboarded locations.
  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity operations, including EDR/MDR, SIEM, vulnerability management, security awareness, identity protection, and incident response.
  • Experience working with:
    • ConnectWise
    • NinjaOne
    • Auvik
    • Liongard
    • Huntress
    • Microsoft Defender
    • IT documentation and knowledge management platforms
  • Experience supporting specialized veterinary or healthcare technologies, including practice management systems, imaging systems, payment technologies, and clinical equipment.
  • Formal project management experience or certification such as PMP, CAPM, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • ITIL Foundation or other IT service management certification.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications.

This is a fully remote U.S.-based position with periodic travel required.

Alliance Animal Health offers a competitive compensation package including salary, bonus opportunity, health benefits, paid time off, professional development opportunities, and the ability to make a meaningful impact across a rapidly growing organization.

This role is intended for an experienced technology leader who is comfortable operating at both the strategic and technical levels. The successful candidate will be expected to lead IT service delivery and major technology initiatives while remaining close enough to the environment to actively participate in troubleshooting, technical decision-making, and practice support when needed.

Alliance Animal Health is a fast-growing, private equity-backed Veterinary Service Organization that operates as a majority owner and business partner to hundreds of veterinary practices across the US. Our goal is to make it easier for our practices at every step by providing world-class business solutions like talent acquisition, marketing, human resources, finance, and operations, so they can focus their energy on providing incredible care for animals. In fact, our Core Values are (quite literally) written with PETS in mind: Passion, Engagement, Trust, and Service.

We want our doctor partners to choose what’s best for their practice because they are the experts in medicine, while we customize the support, the co-ownership approach, and business solutions based on their goals. We pride ourselves on maintaining a culture of open communication and collaboration to deliver innovative solutions to advance today’s veterinary environment, without disrupting the medical autonomy and what makes each of our hospitals unique. Because at the end of the day, our central support team exists to serve our practices. So if you’re excited about using your talents to make an impact on the health and wellness of pets, we’d love to talk with you!

  • Assurer les tests, la qualité, la documentation ainsi que le support de niveau N2/N3.
  • Former les utilisateurs et accompagner la conduite du changement.
  • Encadrer les profils plus juniors au travers du tutorat, de peer reviews, de co-working, d’ateliers et de partages de bonnes pratiques.
  • Évaluer la progression technique des collaborateurs accompagnés et identifier les besoins de formation complémentaires.

📝 Votre profil

  • Vous disposez d’au moins 5 années d’expérience pratique sur SAP FSM.

  • Vous maîtrisez les Mobile Applications SAP FSM.
  • Vous avez une pratique avancée de la configuration des activités, des équipes, des compétences et des SLA.
  • Vous connaissez les Smartforms, les workflows et les Business Rules.
  • Vous justifiez d’une expérience en intégration SAP FSM Cloud avec SAP S/4HANA.

  • Vous pouvez intervenir sur des spécifications liées à l’ABAP, à l’intégration SAP et à SAP CPI.
  • Une expérience en environnement projet IT est attendue.
  • Vous travaillez de manière autonome, structurée et pragmatique.
  • Vous accordez de l’importance à la collaboration, au partage de connaissances, à l’amélioration continue et au sens du service public.

  • Absence d’expérience significative sur SAP FSM.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced IT Operations Technical Lead to serve as the primary technical authority for our infrastructure, network operations, endpoint management, and client connectivity and servers The successful candidate will take ownership of the organization's IT systems, ensuring their security, reliability, performance, and scalability across both cloud and on-premises environments. Working alongside a small IT team, the Technical Lead will lead by example through active involvement in system administration, network troubleshooting, automation, security hardening, and infrastructure optimization while mentoring team members to foster a proactive, accountable, and result-driven culture. The role requires strong technical problem-solving skills, operational discipline, and the ability to independently manage complex IT environments with minimal supervision while maintaining accurate documentation and compliance standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Infrastructure, Networking & Client Connectivity

  • Network Reliability & Triage: Own the end-to-end connectivity path for 300+ agents (both WFH and in-office) connecting to US-based client ERP environments.
  • Network Security: Manage user accounts, role permissions and access controls. Administer and maintain active directory, group policy and DHCP and DNS Services. Implement and monitor firewalls and security hardening standards
  • Proactive Diagnostic Engineering: Deeply analyze network performance using packet loss, latency jitter, hop-by-hop traceroutes, and endpoint resource metrics to isolate issues between local home ISPs, office firewalls, and client VPNs.
  • Routing Strategy: Implement and maintain split tunneling, QoS, dual-ISP failover mechanisms, and bandwidth optimization across distributed environments
  • Backup and Disaster Recovery: Develop, maintain, and update disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity documentation. Conduct periodic backup and lead the DR simulations and post-incident reviews.

2. Cloud, Endpoints & Security Posture

  • Azure & M365 Administration: Own the administration of Azure AD/Entra ID, Microsoft 365, conditional access policies, and hybrid infrastructure.
  • Endpoint & Device Management (MDM): Enforce strict endpoint compliance using Microsoft Intune/SCCM, automated OS patching, disk cleanup policies, local admin rights restrictions, and hardware lifecycle management for remote laptops.
  • AI Integration & Security: Support the secure rollout of AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude Cowork, internal APIs) by enforcing strict sandboxing, M365 data loss prevention (DLP) rules, read-only API scopes, and protection against prompt injection risks.

3. Technical Leadership & Culture Shift (Player-Coach)

  • Lead by Doing: Act as the primary technical escalation point for complex infrastructure, networking, and cloud issues. You are expected to personally troubleshoot and resolve high?priority incidents alongside your team.
  • Transform Team Mindset: Shift the team culture from reactive "order-takers" to proactive systems owners who identify and fix root causes before they impact operations.
  • Granular Mentorship: Conduct daily stand-ups, review ticket diagnostics line-by-line with junior analysts and establish clear accountability and metric-driven SLA targets.

REQUIRED SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Proven Technical Superiority: You must possess deeper hands-on technical skills than everyone on your team in order to earn their respect and mentor them effectively.
  • Hands-on Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or CLI tools to automate routine IT helpdesk tasks, endpoint configuration, and infrastructure provisioning.
  • Deep Networking Diagnostics: Ability to interpret ping payload responses (packet loss/jitter), traceroute latency spikes, routing loops, and firewall/VPN logs to diagnose last-mile ISP vs. core network failures.
  • Cloud & Systems Expertise: Practical experience managing Azure, Intune, Active Directory, Cisco/Meraki or Fortinet firewalls, and modern ITSM tooling (ServiceNow, Jira, or Freshservice).
  • High Operational Urgency: A relentless focus on system uptime, rapid incident resolution, and zero tolerance for recurring unaddressed bugs.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Systems Administration, Network Engineering, or DevOps, with at least 2+ years leading small technical teams or acting as an L3 Lead Engineer.
  • Environment Background: Experience in a fast-paced or high-growth tech environment handling multi-tenant client setups is highly preferred.
  • Certifications (Preferred): Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator / Enterprise Administrator, CCNA, or ITIL v4 Foundation.

About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

The Role

We are looking for a strategy professional to join Kaseya's Corporate Strategy team. This is a high visibility, high impact role that sits at the intersection of data-driven analysis and executive-level decision making. You will work closely with senior leadership to develop strategic recommendations, lead analytical workstreams, and drive special initiatives across the business.

The ideal candidate brings a strong foundation in financial modeling and quantitative analysis — honed through investment banking, management consulting, or corporate finance — combined with intellectual curiosity, strong communication skills, and a genuine interest in how AI tools are reshaping the way strategy work gets done.

This role offers significant breadth: one week you may be building a pricing model to evaluate a go-to-market decision; the next, you may be running a cross-functional working session or preparing materials for a board-level strategic review.

What You'll Do

  • Drive strategic analysis and recommendations — own end-to-end analytical workstreams including market sizing, competitive benchmarking, pricing strategy, business case development, and performance analysis
  • Build financial models to assess and pressure test project feasibility: create bespoke, “on the fly” analyses (e.g., with Excel) to bring quantitative rigor to a wide range of business problems
  • Leverage data to tell compelling stories — pull and manipulate data, synthesize findings, and translate complex analyses into clear, executive-ready narratives and presentations
  • Run meetings and cross-functional processes — facilitate working sessions, manage project timelines, and keep senior stakeholders aligned across fast-moving initiatives projects as they arise
  • Experiment with and champion AI tools — actively explore how AI can improve the quality, speed, and scale of strategy work, and share best practices with the team

What We're Looking For

Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in investment banking, management consulting, corporate finance, or a similar analytically rigorous environment
  • Proven ability to own complex analytical projects independently, from scoping through delivery

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills — comfortable building models from scratch
  • SQL proficiency (or strong willingness to develop it) — ability to query databases, join datasets, and extract insights without relying on data engineering support
  • Familiarity with AI productivity tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, or similar) and a genuine interest in staying ahead of how these tools are evolving

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication — able to distill ambiguous, complex problems into clear frameworks and persuasive recommendations
  • Strong executive presence and comfort running meetings with senior stakeholders
  • Highly organized and structured thinker; able to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Why This Role

  • Direct exposure to C-suite and senior leadership on high-stakes decisions
  • Broad remit across Kaseya's full business — pricing, competitive strategy, M&A, product strategy, and more
  • A team that moves fast, thinks rigorously, and has real influence on company direction

📋 Tâches et responsabilités

VERSION FR

Fonction

Le functional analyst intervient sur l'analyse des processus métiers. En amont du projet, il décrit de manière précise la situation actuelle et la situation cible. Il anime des ateliers, organise les réunions nécessaires à la collecte d'informations et rédige les livrables utiles à la définition du projet, dans le respect des standards et de la méthodologie en place.

Responsabilités du poste

  • Organiser les réunions et ateliers nécessaires pour comprendre et cartographier les processus métiers attendus.
  • Rédiger les documents de définition du processus afin qu'ils puissent être exploités directement par les analystes chargés de l'implémentation de la solution.
  • Veiller, tout au long du projet, à la cohérence entre la solution implémentée et la solution définie avec le Business.
  • Formaliser les besoins à l'aide de user stories, use cases, BPMN et UML lorsque cela est requis.
  • Contribuer à l'approche de testing afin de vérifier que la solution répond correctement aux besoins fonctionnels.

Compétences comportementales

  • Communication: organiser et animer des réunions ou ateliers avec le Business, avec une écoute active.
  • Conceptualiser: traduire des raisonnements et concepts abstraits en solutions concrètes.
  • Analyser l'information: examiner les données de manière ciblée et porter un regard critique sur l'information.
  • Compréhension transversale: dépasser les frontières entre services ou directions et évaluer l'impact des décisions sur d'autres domaines de l'organisation.
  • Storytelling: structurer et présenter l'information de façon claire pour faciliter la compréhension et l'adhésion des parties prenantes.

NL VERSIE

Functie

De functioneel analist staat in voor de analyse van bedrijfsprocessen. In de voorbereidende fase van een project brengt hij of zij de huidige en toekomstige situatie van het proces nauwkeurig in kaart. Daarnaast leidt de analist workshops, organiseert de nodige vergaderingen om informatie te verzamelen en werkt de vereiste deliverables uit volgens de geldende standaarden en methodologie.

🛠️ Verantwoordelijkheden

  • Vergaderingen en workshops organiseren om bedrijfsprocessen goed te begrijpen en in kaart te brengen.
  • Documentatie opstellen die nodig is om het proces te definiëren, zodat analisten hiermee meteen aan de slag kunnen voor de implementatie van de oplossing.
  • Tijdens het volledige project bewaken dat de geïmplementeerde oplossing overeenstemt met wat samen met de Business werd beschreven.
  • Functionele behoeften vertalen naar user stories, use cases, BPMN en UML waar nodig.
  • Bijdragen aan testing om na te gaan of de oplossing correct aansluit op de functionele verwachtingen.

Gedragsvaardigheden

  • Communicatie: organiseert en begeleidt de nodige vergaderingen of workshops met de Business en beschikt over sterke luistervaardigheden.

  • Informatie analyseren: gegevens gericht analyseren en informatie kritisch beoordelen.
  • Transversaal inzicht: over de grenzen van verschillende afdelingen of directies heen kijken en de impact van beslissingen op andere domeinen inschatten.
  • Storytelling: informatie helder structureren en overbrengen naar stakeholders.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Ervaring als functional analyst.
  • Grondige kennis van Agile / Scrum en BPMN.
  • Ervaring met Storytelling, Testing, UML, use cases en user stories.
  • Je werkt vlot samen met business stakeholders en kan functionele informatie helder documenteren.
  • Je communiceert professioneel in Dutch, English en French.

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

Our mission at Greenhouse is to make hiring work for everyone – so we go to great lengths to hire great people because we believe that they’re the foundation of our success. At Greenhouse, you’ll join a team that collaborates purposefully, fosters inclusivity, and communicates with transparency and accountability so we can achieve our mission.

Join us to do the best work of your career, solving meaningful problems with remarkable teams.

Greenhouse is looking for a Vice President, Security to lead company-wide security strategy and execution across product security, corporate security, and information security.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role will lead the Security team and create trust by protecting candidate and employee data. This leader will take a first-principles approach to evolving our security program as we scale to our next stage of growth and complexity. As a member of the Senior Leadership Team and R&D Leadership Team, you’ll advise executive leadership and the Board on security posture, risk, and investments. You’ll also partner closely with Product, Legal, Engineering, Privacy, Sales, and Customer Success as Greenhouse scales its data platform and AI-enabled product capabilities responsibly.


Who will love this job

  • A strategic, hands-on leader who sets direction for an entire security organization and still engages deeply with technical details when it matters
  • A leader who moves with urgency and is energized by an ambitious growth plan, scaling the security program at the pace the business needs without trading away customer trust
  • A leader of leaders who develops managers and directors, builds a strong bench, and creates a team culture of ownership, curiosity, inclusion, and continuous learning
  • A calm incident leader who brings clarity under pressure and communicates decisively with company leadership, customers, and regulators

  • A trust builder who sees security as a competitive advantage and earns credibility with the ELT, the Board, customers, and auditors
  • An agile communicator who translates complex security and technology risks into clear recommendations for executives, the Board, customers, and partners


What you’ll do

  • Define and own Greenhouse’s security strategy, multi-year roadmap, operating model, budget, and investment priorities
  • Lead a multidisciplinary security organization spanning product security, corporate security, and information security. Build it to be AI-native, using automation and agentic workflows to scale assessments, triage, investigations, and compliance evidence
  • Build and develop a strong leadership bench, including hiring, coaching, succession planning, and career development
  • Own Greenhouse’s security risk posture, including enterprise, third-party, and vendor risk, and risk acceptance decisions. Set risk appetite with the ELT and oversee compliance and assurance programs, including SOC 1, SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and ISO 42001
  • Lead security response for serious incidents, from detection and triage through executive, customer, regulatory, and post-incident communications
  • Own annual disaster recovery exercises with Platform Engineering and regulatory notification timelines
  • Establish governance for how AI is used across Greenhouse, by our people and in our product, including acceptable-use policies and standards, data handling, access boundaries, human oversight, and auditability
  • Lead Greenhouse’s data security and governance program, including data classification, access controls, data loss prevention, and data residency, in partnership with Privacy and Legal
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, IT, Legal, Privacy, and Finance on secure-by-default design, identity, and customer commitments
  • Advise Sales and Customer Success on strategic security reviews and enterprise deals, and join customer trust conversations with CISOs and CTOs as needed
  • Represent Greenhouse security with the Board, customers, prospects, partners, auditors, and industry audiences
  • Lead security due diligence and integration for mergers and acquisitions


You should have

  • 12+ years of experience in security, including 5+ years leading a multidisciplinary security organization
  • Experience serving as a Head of Security, CISO, Vice President of Security, or comparable senior security leader
  • Experience owning an end-to-end security program and scaling a security organization through significant growth at a B2B SaaS or consumer technology company, ideally with exposure to both, including strategy, budget, and headcount planning
  • Experience across security operations, cloud security, product security, identity and access management, risk, compliance, and incident response
  • Experience leading serious security incidents in partnership with Legal, communications, executives, customers, and regulators
  • Experience working with external auditors and leading compliance and assurance programs such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001
  • Experience presenting security posture, material risks, investment needs, and trade-offs to executive leadership and a Board
  • Experience securing cloud environments such as AWS and Kubernetes, and working with modern identity standards and platforms including Okta, OpenID Connect, or SAML
  • Experience with AI security, AI governance, responsible AI, or securing AI-enabled products
  • Experience with ISO 42001, ISO 27701, GDPR, the EU AI Act, HR technology, or products handling sensitive personal data, a plus
  • Your own unique talents! Your background has given you a unique perspective and set of transferable skills that aren't always in alignment with a given role - but those are qualities we value at Greenhouse. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, we still strongly encourage you to apply

What to expect

  • This role will be posted until November 6th, 2026.
  • All candidates will be invited to complete a Voice AI interview. Since this role leads our Security team including AI security at Greenhouse, it’s a chance to experience the product firsthand, but if you need an accommodation or a different format, let your recruiter know.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud, for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC), which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.

Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.

Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.

As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:

  • Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
  • Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
  • Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
  • Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
  • Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments

We’re excited about you because you have

  • 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
  • Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
  • Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
  • Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
  • Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
  • Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offerings such as AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, AWS European Sovereign Cloud, or GCP Sovereign Cloud
  • Experience with pricing and packaging across deployment models
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, or other data-intensive infrastructure products
  • Experience working with resellers, systems integrators, or cloud marketplace partners
  • Familiarity with open source software or commercial open source companies

In the United States, the base compensation range for this role is $208,602- $250,322. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed throughout the interview process. All of our roles include Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), giving every team member ownership in Grafana Labs' success. We believe in shared outcomes—RSUs help us stay aligned and invested as we scale globally.

*Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.

Why You’ll Thrive at Grafana Labs:

  • 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
  • Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
  • Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
  • Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
  • Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
  • Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
  • Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
  • Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
  • Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
  • In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
  • Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. *We will comply with local legislation where applicable.

Equal Opportunity Employer:Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. Global B2B Ecommerce Capability Performance & Optimization Analysis

The project will focus on understanding how B2B ecommerce capabilities are being utilized across Seagate's Direct Store and global eTail/Retail channels, where performance differs across markets, and what factors may be contributing to those differences.
