Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Hours: Full-time, salaried (40hrs/week), Mon-Fri, 7:30am-9pm ET rotating shifts and rotating Saturdays 7:00am-5pm ET

The Opportunity:

As a BlinkRx Pharmacist, you are the clinical backbone of our closed-door facility. You will verify prescriptions with speed and precision, provide proactive phone-based patient counseling, and collaborate with prescribers to keep medications moving without compromising safety. This role is ideal for pharmacists who thrive in a structured, high-throughput environment and are passionate about improving patient outcomes at scale.

Responsibilities:

Prescription Verification and Dispensing

  • Review and clinically verify new and refill prescriptions for therapeutic appropriateness, drug-drug interactions, contraindications, and dosing accuracy
  • Validate prescription data entry performed by pharmacy technicians, ensuring transcription accuracy from provider orders and transfer records
  • Perform pharmacist verification of filled prescriptions in a closed-door fulfillment environment, confirming accuracy of drug, dose, quantity, NDC, and labeling prior to release for shipment
  • Perform daily prospective drug utilization review (DUR) to identify and resolve clinical flags before fulfillment
  • Manage specialty medication handling requirements including cold-chain verification

Patient Care

All patient interaction at BlinkRx is conducted by phone or digital platforms. Our pharmacists are the primary clinical contact for patients and must deliver a high standard of care in every call.

  • Provide proactive outbound patient counseling calls for new prescriptions, addressing drug education, expected side effects, dosing instructions, storage requirements, and adherence strategies
  • Handle inbound clinical patient calls related to counseling and clinical inquiries, while directing non-clinical inquiries, such as refill status and delivery questions, to the patient support team.
  • Document all patient interactions thoroughly in the patient profile within the pharmacy management system
  • Support Spanish-speaking patients with bilingual counseling where applicable

Prescriber Collaboration and Clinical Outreach

  • Contact prescriber offices via phone and electronic messaging to clarify incomplete, ambiguous, or clinically inappropriate prescriptions prior to dispensing
  • Partner with prescribers on therapeutic substitutions, DAW overrides, and formulary alternatives to reduce dispensing delays

Pharmacy Technician Supervision and Workflow Management

  • Supervise pharmacy technicians across data entry, prescription processing, packaging, and fulfillment workflows in accordance with state board regulations and in collaboration with technician management
  • Conduct real-time quality checks on technician work product, providing immediate corrective feedback to maintain accuracy standards
  • Identify and escalate technician performance trends to pharmacy leadership; participate in coaching and training as directed

Compliance, Safety and Quality

  • Ensure strict compliance with HIPAA, state pharmacy practice acts, federal DEA regulations, and all BlinkRx corporate policies
  • Oversee proper handling, documentation, and destruction of PHI-containing records and materials in alignment with privacy protocols
  • Participate in quality assurance activities including internal audits, prescription error tracking, and near-miss reporting
  • Report adverse drug events and medication errors through established pharmacovigilance channels, when applicable
  • Maintain fulfillment area compliance standards, including proper storage of temperature-sensitive medications

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with pharmacy leadership, patient services, clinical, compliance, and technology teams to drive operational and clinical improvements
  • Coordinate with the shipping and fulfillment team to resolve packaging errors, return-to-sender issues, and delivery failures affecting patient medication access
  • Provide clinical input on technology enhancements, workflow tools, and software configurations that affect the pharmacist verification or patient counseling experience
  • Participate in team huddles, quality reviews, and department meetings to support continuous improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

Required

  • Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) degree from an ACPE-accredited College of Pharmacy
  • Active Missouri Pharmacy License in good standing with the Missouri Board of Pharmacy
  • Strong command of the English language (written and verbal); bilingual Spanish preferred for phone-based patient counseling
  • Demonstrated ability to perform high-volume prescription verification with strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn pharmacy management systems, verification platforms, and internal workflow tools

Preferred

  • 3+ years of experience in a mail order, specialty, retail or closed-door fulfillment pharmacy
  • Active pharmacy licensure required in home state; candidates must obtain licensure in 3 additional states from the list below within the first 9 months of hire (prior licensure in any of the following states is a plus):
    • AK, AL, AR, CA, ID, IL, KS, KY, LA, MA, MD, MI, MS, NE, NV, OK, OR, TN, TX, VA, WV
  • Familiarity with pharmacovigilance or adverse drug event reporting protocols

What Success Looks Like:

  • Prescription verification queues are processed accurately and on time without sacrificing clinical quality
  • Every patient who receives a counseling call feels informed, supported, and confident in their therapy
  • Prescriber outreach is proactive and efficient, minimizing dispensing delays caused by incomplete or unclear orders
  • Compliance and quality standards are upheld without exception in a fast-paced environment
  • You are a trusted clinical partner within the BlinkRx team — shaping the patient experience from behind the scenes

At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. jobs.excerpt: Diversity.  Inclusion.  They’re more than just words for us.
jobs.description:
Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

The Role

As Staff Software Development Engineer, you'll be the Windows kernel authority for the runtime enforcement layer of our Identity Security Platform. These components decide, in-kernel, whether to permit or deny each action an identity or AI agent attempts on a Windows endpoint.

You'll set the technical direction for kernel-mode enforcement on Windows and own it end to end. That means hooks that make the right call in real time, across the fleet, without breaking legitimate workloads. Peer engineers own the macOS and Linux enforcement surfaces. You share one policy language, one event schema, and one userspace agent with them, but Windows kernel-space is yours.

You know this layer better than anyone. You want your code to be the thing that stops a compromised credential or a runaway AI coding agent before it impacts production.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own our kernel-mode enforcement drivers: file-system, process and thread creation, handle operations, and registry access. You'll block operations inline in the kernel rather than logging them after the fact, and you'll build the userspace agent that installs and drives them.
  • Own the kernel/user-mode enforcement boundary: kernel-side event capture, policy evaluation in user mode, and deny decisions pushed back into the driver as hash-keyed caches so subsequent hits block inline.
  • Drive down enforce-mode latency on the operation hot path as we scale across large fleets. That means process enrichment, image-hash caching and eviction under heavy process-churn, and process-ancestry resolution across PPID spoofing.
  • Extend enforcement into containers and isolation: Windows containers and Host Compute Service workloads, silo- and job-object-aware policy, and container identity on kernel events. Most of this is greenfield, and it sits at the center of the role.
  • Harden portability and stability across Windows builds so enforcement loads and behaves correctly on the versions customers actually run. You'll deal with structure-versioning across Windows releases, PatchGuard constraints, Driver Verifier and HVCI compliance, WHQL attestation signing, and graceful degradation when a capability isn't available.
  • Partner with the Linux and macOS enforcement engineers and the policy-backend team on the shared plane: policy semantics, cross-stack conformance, event schema, the common Rust agent. You'll represent Windows in cross-org architecture reviews.
  • Read requirements to find gaps and risks, propose simplifications, and explain tradeoffs to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Raise the engineering bar. You'll take end-to-end ownership from design through production, and you'll carry extra weight where a kernel bug means a wrong security decision or a bugcheck across the fleet, not just a crash of one process.
  • Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on Windows systems and kernel-driver craft.

What You’ll Bring

This is a Windows specialist role, so the depth requirements are real:

  • Deep Windows kernel internals - the I/O manager and IRP flow, the object manager, process and thread structures, memory management, the Windows security model (tokens, SIDs, ACLs) - backed by production kernel-mode driver development in C, C++, or Rust.
  • Hands-on kernel-mode driver work for security enforcement. You've shipped a file-system minifilter or comparable callback-based driver, and you can reason about IRQL, synchronization, safe user-buffer access, and reentrancy in the kernel. You know how to keep a driver off the crash path when a dependency misbehaves.
  • Driver signing and deployment reality: WHQL attestation, EV code signing, the WDK and WDF/KMDF, and the operational cost of shipping kernel code to a large install base.
  • The Windows isolation model - job objects, silos, Windows containers, AppContainer - and how it intersects with kernel-level security tooling.
  • Kernel debugging and performance tooling: WinDbg and KD, live-kernel and crash-dump analysis, ETW, Driver Verifier, and the checked-build workflow.
  • 8+ years in systems-level software engineering, with real depth in Windows kernel development.
  • Demonstrated AI-first development. We build this platform through agentic tooling. AI-driven design exploration, code generation, adversarial plan review, and automated pre-merge quality gates are how work ships here, not a side experiment. You use Claude Code or a comparable tool as a core part of your daily workflow, and you can speak concretely to how it raises both your velocity and your rigor. That matters most in correctness- and security-critical kernel code, where you have to know exactly when to stop and verify by hand.
  • A working grasp of systems design patterns and their tradeoffs at the kernel/user-mode boundary.
  • Full-lifecycle experience, including product release, in an agile environment.
  • A track record of technical leadership on complex, ambiguous initiatives that span teams.

Who You Are

  • You share successes and failures openly, and you work well with people. You adapt when the situation and the requirements shift. You fix issues before anyone assigns them to you, and you stay persistent through roadblocks, pulling in others when you need to.
  • You hold a high bar and push your teams to ship reliable systems, especially where a kernel bug carries outsized risk. You know systems software best practices, from rigorous testing to sharp peer review to architecture that survives contact with production.
  • You reach for AI tools to move faster and think more clearly, and you keep the judgment to slow down and verify by hand when the code demands it. You weigh speed against risk and decide from data.
  • You feel the weight of enforcement code. You'd rather ship a correct block a day late than a wrong one now, and you choose your failure modes - fail-open or fail-closed - on purpose instead of by accident.

Better Together

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.

About Us

BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. jobs.title: Applied Real World Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: Evio OverviewEvio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.
jobs.description:
Evio Overview

Evio is a highly unique pharmacy solutions company that was founded by and works closely with health plans to implement transformative (to cost, quality, access and experience) initiatives primarily focused on specialty and other high-cost medication solutions.

In 2020, a group of five amazing Blue Cross Blue Shield health plans that in total serve more than 20 million members recognized that the way medications get to patients needs significant reform—rapidly rising costs and massive system complexities are detrimental to patients and the entire industry. In 2025, Wellmark joined as Evio's first non-founding investor and sixth owner health plan. Each company made, and continues to make, significant investments to establish Evio as an independent entity to lead this transformation.  

Evio has advanced analytics and contracting capabilities at scale, and a suite of digital tools, to power our high-cost medication solutions. Our solutions act as a self-reinforcing “flywheel” where each element strengthens and feeds into the next, and support an “Only Evio can do that,” mindset and prioritization.

Evio is also a company that has invested heavily in and been highly intentional about people, team and culture. We believe we have created a very special place to work and encourage candidates to observe and ask us about our culture and decide for themselves.

Evio's Values

  • Empathy– The people our business serves always come first. We care for our teammates and put ourselves in the shoes of our health plan customers and the patients and clinicians our solutions benefit.
  • Diversity – We are committed to fostering a culture where everyone belongs and is valued for their background, experience and insights – one that encourages diversity of ideas, and is a nurturing, trusting, and accepting place for all.
  • Adventure – We are flexible, thrive in ambiguity, fail fast, and pivot quickly to get to a better answer. We celebrate wins and pivots with equal intensity.
  • Relentless – Guided by evidence and data, we are creative, curious, and unwavering in our pursuit of challenging the status quo and each other.
  • Transparency – Just as we seek to bring transparency to the pharmacy supply chain, authenticity and integrity are core to the way we communicate.
  • Excellence – We strive to raise the bar in all we do by hiring and developing exceptional talent and holding ourselves and our thinking to the highest standard.

About the role

As an Applied Real-World Data Scientist, you will lead the development and execution of research, analytics, and reporting powering Evio Insights, a product within our Digital Health portfolio. Evio Insights uses real-world evidence (RWE) to generate recommendations related to policy and utilization management, prescriber and patient outreach, care management, and contracting to support high-value medication use.

In this role, you will collaborate with teammates across engineering, data, and client-facing teams to uncover insights from our data that help patients access high-cost medications in a simple and affordable way. You will use your analytical skills, innovative mindset, and tenacity to discover ways health plans can improve patients’ medication experiences. Your technical skills, curiosity, and health plan empathy will drive the evolution of Evio Insights to ensure it continues to meet the needs of health plan customers.

You will own the analytic lifecycle from problem to recommendation: you’ll translate ambiguous health plan problems into research questions, selecting the appropriate study or modeling approach, executing the analysis, and communicating clear, actionable recommendations.

What you will do:

Analytics and product innovation

  • Develop reusable analytical frameworks, study templates, and automated workflows to improve scalability, efficiency, quality, and consistency across Evio Insights
  • Explore data to identify signals, trends, utilization patterns, and anomalies that inform project hypotheses and strategic decision-making
  • Apply machine learning and advanced analytics techniques (such as predictive modeling, natural language processing, graph neural networks, and unsupervised clustering) to develop and advance product capabilities
  • Evaluate new data sources, analytical methods, and advanced analytics approaches—including predictive modeling, forecasting, and patient segmentation—to determine their potential value for Evio Insights.
  • Contribute to project planning, prioritization, quality review, and continuous improvement of Evio Insights research and analytics.

Product delivery

  • Design and execute RWE projects—including observational studies, comparative effectiveness studies, predictive modeling of cost/clinical outcomes, and other analytics projects focused on patient outcomes, medication utilization, and healthcare costs
  • Collaborate with pharmacists, RWE/HEOR researchers, data scientists, analysts, engineers, product managers, and client-facing teammates to deliver high-quality analyses and evidence
  • Develop clear analytical plans, outcome definitions, and validation approaches that produce reliable and decision-ready evidence
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable insights through presentations, slide decks, manuscripts, and client-facing communications
  • Conduct feasibility assessments and exploratory analyses to identify and evaluate research and analytics project opportunities

Reporting and value measurement

  • Develop reporting and data visualizations summarizing the impact and cost-savings potential of Evio Insights recommendations to health plans
  • Apply appropriate program-evaluation methods—such as matched comparisons, difference-in-differences, interrupted time-series analyses, or other quasi-experimental approaches to assess the impact of interventions, including prescriber outreach, member outreach, and policy and utilization management changes
  • Develop reporting that identifies emerging medication utilization and cost trends, surfaces potential clinical and financial opportunities, and supports RWE study ideation, prioritization, and strategic decision-making.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, real-world evidence, health economics and outcomes research, data science, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience with machine learning and advanced analytical methods, such as predictive modeling, forecasting, and unsupervised learning/segmentation.
  • Experience working with administrative claims data
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and experience with at least one analytical programming language, such as Python or R.
  • Experience designing statistical comparisons, analytical plans, and decision-grade analyses for a variety of use case
  • Skills to design and execute descriptive analytics, outcomes-based analytics, and predictive analytics
  • Experience developing automated, reusable, or production-ready analytical workflows and reporting solutions.
  • Ability to communicate technical information to a range of audiences including executives, analysts, actuaries, and clinicians—via written and verbal communication
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to independently explore data, identify insights, and recommend actionable solutions

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience working with healthcare data beyond administrative claims, such as prior authorization, laboratory, electronic health records, or social determinants of health.
  • Familiarity with commercially available real-world data analytics platforms
  • Experience using AI to analyze real-world data, automate workflows, or perform quality assurance
  • Familiarity with high-cost and specialty medications and how they are managed by health plans via medical policy, utilization management, and formularies

How you show up:

  • Founder's mentality: You prototype, create, and iterate without waiting for permission or perfect infrastructure.
  • Resilient and pragmatic: You are comfortable with ambiguity, escalation, and imperfect information, and you choose practical, high-leverage solutions over perfection.
  • Bias for outcomes: Your core focus is creating value for customers and the patients they impact. As a relentless self-starter, you are oriented to take action to solve a problem.
  • Exceptional communicator: You can communicate crisply with payer executives, internal leaders, product experts, and others regardless of whether they have a technical background.
  • EQ and relationship building: You build strong internal and external relationships and navigate complex organizations with empathy, awareness, and overall high emotional intelligence
  • Structured thinking: You’re an organized thinker and able to manage multiple priorities without losing momentum
  • Judgement and balance: You balance thoughtful analysis with speed, knowing when to go deep and when to move fast.
  • Innovation: You bring energy, curiosity, and excitement for challenging the status quo with strong value alignment to Evio’s vision

Compensation:

Anticipated annual base pay range: $160,000 - $190,000 plus additional variable compensation.

At Evio, we’re committed to building a competitive compensation package to honor the value our teammates bring as well as attract and retain top talent that is aligned with our culture, mission and values. Compensation includes base pay (range shown) and could include other variable compensation opportunities depending on job seniority, location, and date of hire. Evio also offers a number of attractive benefits to eligible teammates including health insurance, retirement savings, life and disability insurance, paid and unpaid time off, and other benefits to make sure Evio teammates and families are well supported.

Please note that the base pay information shown is a general guideline for the job responsibilities and qualifications listed. Salary decisions are based on candidate experience, and market and business considerations.

How we take care of you:

  • Great Health InsuranceThe company pays 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for teammates, and 50% for dependents.
  • 401K Match
    Evio matches 100% of teammate contribution up to 5% of salary, subject to IRS limits.
  • Time Off
    We have a flexible vacation policy for teammates to unplug and recharge when you need it. There is no minimum or maximum amount of vacation allowed per year, and there is no payment in consideration for unused vacation. Vacation is to be used at your discretion, with approval of leadership.
  • Parental Leave
    Generous paid leave for new parents (includes birth and non-birth parents).

Fraud Notice

We’ve recently learned of fraudulent job postings and individuals falsely claiming to represent Evio. Protecting our candidates is incredibly important to us, and we want to share a few reminders:
  • All official communication will come from an email ending in @evio.com.
  • We will never conduct text-only interviews (Teams, SMS, WhatsApp, Telegram, etc.).
  • We will never ask for payment, gift cards, fees, or purchases of any kind.
  • We will never request sensitive financial information during the recruiting process.
  • Our open roles are posted only on our official website, LinkedIn, and Greenhouse job board.
If you believe you’ve encountered a scam, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission or the Internet Crime Complaint Center. Thank you for your care and vigilance — we’re grateful to everyone who helps keep our community safe.

Information Disclosure

We value transparency in our hiring process and want applicants to understand how your information is used.

We collect and use personal information you provide during the application process such as your resume, employment history, education, interview responses, and other job-related information, to evaluate your qualifications for employment. This may also include limited technical and interaction data, such as IP address and device or browser information.

We may use automated or AI-assisted tools to help review applications, identify qualified candidates, and detect or investigate potentially fraudulent or deceptive activity. Human reviewers remain involved, and these tools support, not replace, human judgment.

These measures support a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation, please inform us when invited to interview.

California privacy notice Consistent with California law, we use this information for recruiting, hiring, and related business purposes, including evaluating your candidacy and improving our hiring processes.

jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

As a Staff Data Engineer on the Migrations team, you are the end-to-end technical and operational owner of client migrations. You will drive the full lifecycle, from deep-dive legacy analysis to production deployment, while orchestrating collaboration across Operations, Client Success, Product, Data Science and Platform Engineering. You don't just implement; you own the outcome.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role for someone who can think like an architect, execute like a senior engineer, and coordinate like a program manager — all on the same project. You'll own the problem space from discovery to go-live, making the defining architectural decisions and writing the code that brings them to life.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead discovery & technical due diligence — get to the bottom of poorly documented legacy systems (ETL, stored procedures, reporting layers, file feeds), reconstruct the business logic, and capture it in the lineage maps, mapping specs, and risk analyses everyone builds from.
  • Reverse-engineer complex legacy systems using agents— you will be responsible for reverse-engineering complex, undocumented legacy systems (SSIS packages, stored procedures) where business logic is embedded, not documented. You must be able to reconstruct the intent of these systems to build modern, stable equivalents.
  • Drive ambiguity to resolution — spot the unknowns early, own the open questions, and pull answers from clients, SMEs, and Operations instead of waiting to be unblocked.
  • Architect & build the migration pipelines — turn intricate legacy logic into production-grade Airflow DAGs and Spark jobs on the Machinify platform, edge cases, payer-specific carve-outs, and business-rule exceptions included, owning the full flow from ingestion through reconciliation to steady-state handoff.
  • Make and document the hard architectural calls — own the decisions that matter (pipeline design, partitioning strategy, validation approach) and leave a clear trail of the reasoning so others can learn from and build on it.
  • Prove correctness at scale — build automated reconciliation frameworks that confirm, with confidence, that migrated output matches the source down to the row.
  • Own the program end to end — be the single technical owner from kickoff through go-live and hypercare: scope, sequence, and track the work, surface risks before they bite, align Operations, Client Success, Platform Engineering, SMEs, and the client, and drive UAT through to sign-off.
  • Raise the bar for the practice — Institutionalize migration knowledge by codifying runbooks and retrospectives, mentor L3/L4 engineers to build independent capability, and turn recurring migration pain points into scalable, reusable tooling.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years as a hands-on Data Engineer or Software Engineer, with demonstrated experience independently owning complex, multi-stakeholder technical projects from start to finish.
  • Strong Python and SQL — fluent with complex, unfamiliar legacy code, not just greenfield work.
  • Apache Spark — deep understanding of distributed processing, performance tuning, partitioning, and debugging at scale.
  • Apache Airflow — advanced; comfortable designing and authoring production DAG architectures from scratch.
  • AI-assisted development — actively uses coding agents (Claude, Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) as a force multiplier in daily engineering work. Comfortable prompt-engineering for code generation, debugging, and documentation, and able to evaluate and trust AI output critically.
  • Legacy ETL stack — able to reconstruct intent from code and translate it faithfully into a modern stack (e.g., From SSIS, SQL Server stored procedures, T-SQL, or equivalent).
  • Data validation & reconciliation at scale — experience designing automated frameworks that prove migrated data matches source systems with high confidence.
  • AWS — proficient with S3, solid grasp of cloud-native data patterns such as partitioned object storage, secure cross-account access, and cost/performance trade-offs.
  • Cross-functional coordination — proven ability to drive alignment across engineering, operations, and client-facing teams simultaneously, without losing velocity.
  • Clear technical communication — able to write discovery specs, architecture docs, and stakeholder updates that are accurate, concise, and actionable for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Data-first mindset & fidelity — a rigorous, data-first mindset, with deep experience in building automated reconciliation frameworks that guarantee 100% data fidelity between legacy and modern systems.

🌱 Why Join Us

  • Full ownership — you own the whole arc of a migration, from first look to go-live. No fragmented handoffs — just the autonomy and context to do it well.
  • Immediate business impact — every migration you land enables a health plan to process claims more accurately and efficiently.
  • Technical depth + breadth — you'll work across legacy systems, modern orchestration, distributed compute, cloud infra, and client-facing delivery in every project.
  • Pivotal moment — we're scaling the migrations capability for a fast-growing platform; the standards and patterns you set will shape how dozens of future migrations run

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Full Medical/Dental/Vision for employees & their families
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work
  • Unlimited FTO
  • Competitive salary, equity, 401(k) including employer match

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. The base salary range for this role is $180k-$220k. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

We are looking for a Manager Enterprise Application Engineering to join the OppFi Technology team. This role will report directly to the Sr Director Platform and Operations and lead a team of engineers in support of OppFi’s technology efforts.

What you get to do:

As an Enterprise Application Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of talented engineers, acting as their technical mentor and professional guide. Your mission is to be the trusted technology partner that transforms business operations by building a secure, scalable, and automated environment that empowers our employees, protects our data, and accelerates our business.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

  • Lead, mentor, and build a world-class team of Enterprise Application Engineers.
  • Be responsible for hiring, onboarding, performance management, and the career development of your direct reports.
  • Act as the "player-coach" and most senior technical expert for your team, capable of unblocking your engineers, leading complex architecture reviews, and troubleshooting the most challenging issues.

Strategy & Business Partnership

Identity & Access Management (IAM)

  • Architect, build, and maintain robust integrations between our core business systems.
  • Be responsible for the reliability and integrity of data as it moves between integrated systems, including error handling and monitoring.

  • 7+ years in Enterprise Systems or Application Engineering, with a demonstrable focus on automation and integration.
    At least 3+ years in a people management or technical lead role.

  • Deep architectural and administrative experience with the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence), with the ability to design and implement complex workflows for both technical and business teams.

jobs.excerpt: Company BackgroundCensys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet.
jobs.description:
Company Background

Censys’ mission is to be the one place to understand everything on the internet. Frustrated by the lack of trustworthy Internet intelligence, we set out to create the industry’s most comprehensive, accurate, and up-to-date map of the Internet. Today, Censys delivers real-time Internet intelligence and actionable threat insights to global governments, over 50% of the Fortune 500, and leading threat intelligence providers worldwide.

We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to scale execution of the Censys Internet Map: the most continuously updated view of every asset, port, service, and certificate we can find across the public internet. Building it means running one of the largest internet-wide scanning operations in the world - 400+ Protocols providing access to 3Trillion+ scans in our APIs, 10PetaBytes+ of historical data, scanning 250Million+ IPs across 65K ports daily, resolving 8Billion+ names every 24 hours and tracking DNS at scale, tracking 18B+ certificates, fingerprinting 100K+ technologies behind what we find, enriching all of it with human readable labels, and third-party context so it becomes actionable intelligence rather than raw data.

This role is anchored in disciplined delivery, translating complex coverage and enrichment priorities into requirements engineering can build against. You'll define business and customer priorities, run the delivery cadence, and keep engineering and cross-functional stakeholders aligned on what's shipping and why it matters.

What You’ll Do

Internet Map Execution: You will define the business and customer priorities behind what goes into the Internet Map and how it stays best-in-class. This is the lever that enables Censys to be successful across every product and every segment we operate in.

  • Coverage: How do we grow the map, how often we refresh it, and how comprehensively? This spans expanding IPv4/IPv6 scan scope, adding and prioritizing ports and protocols, increasing scan and DNS resolution frequency, and improving certificate and host discovery. You'll define this data collection work as detailed engineering requirements and acceptance criteria, and track coverage against baselines to identify and close gaps.
  • Context: How do we enrich data into actionable intelligence? You'll define enrichment priorities based on customer and product needs: technology fingerprinting, risk scoring, and third-party data integrations. This includes evaluating external/third-party data sources for accuracy, coverage, and cost; defining the metrics used to judge data and enrichment quality; defining the schema that structures how coverage and context data is represented; and writing the documentation that makes both understandable and usable internally and externally.

Cross-Team Alignment and Execution:

  • Drive cross-functional data prioritization across the Censys suite and provide business priority input into sequencing for new protocols and enrichments, ensuring data investments align with company goals, resolve multi-product conflicts, and provide roadmap transparency to other product managers and EMs.

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Workday Platform Engineer within the G&A IT Applications team to serve as the primary technical owner of the Workday platform across HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Prism Analytics, Illuminate (AI/ML), integrations, security, and release management.

This is a builder-first role. You will configure, develop, integrate, and operate within Workday while partnering closely with HR, Payroll, Finance, and IT stakeholders. You own the technical platform layer configuration, integrations, security architecture, governance, and release discipline, while HR and Payroll retain ownership of sensitive data and business policy logic.

Key Responsibilities

Platform Ownership & Delivery:

  • Own technical execution across Workday HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Prism Analytics, and Illuminate.
  • Translate business requirements into phased technical delivery plans.
  • Manage sandbox strategy, tenant lifecycle, and biannual release readiness.

Hands-On Configuration & Development:

  • Configure HCM and Recruiting modules.Build advanced reports (matrix, composite, BIRT), calculated fields, validations, and business process frameworks.
  • Leverage Workday Extend to design and build lightweight custom applications that enhance core workflows.
  • Maintain scalable security models and governance standards.

Integrations & Architecture:

  • Build and maintain integrations (EIB, Studio, REST/SOAP APIs, RaaS).
  • Integrate with applications like ERP, identity providers, benefits carriers, and third-party systems.
  • Ensure secure, reusable integration frameworks with monitoring and error-handling discipline.

Analytics, AI & Automation:

  • Implement and manage Workday Prism Analytics datasets and dashboards.
  • Enable Workday Illuminate capabilities and intelligent workflows.
  • Drive automation while maintaining audit and compliance standards.

Security & Compliance:

  • Own Workday security architecture and least-privilege access models.
  • Implement enhanced logging and monitoring for sensitive data access, extracts, and downloads.
  • Ensure encryption in transit and at rest across integrations and reporting.
  • Enforce non-production data masking and scrubbing practices.
  • Support SOX, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance requirements.

Separation of Duties

This role owns platform configuration, integrations, and technical governance.
It does not include direct access to sensitive employee data or ownership of HR policy logic.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of hands-on Workday technical experience.
  • Workday Pro certifications (HCM, Integrations, Security, Prism).
  • Strong experience building Workday integrations (EIB, Studio, APIs).
  • Deep expertise in security configuration, business process framework design, and reporting.
  • Experience with Prism Analytics.
  • Exposure to Workday Extend.
  • High documentation skills with solid understanding of ITGC controls & Change management policies and operational rigor.
  • Platform ownership mindset with strong technical depth.
  • Experience operating in regulated environments.
  • Proven ability to deliver complex platform initiatives end-to-end.
  • Strong stakeholder communication and governance mindset.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Exposure to Workday Illuminate / AI features.
  • Experience with Workday ecosystem add-ons (e.g., Paradox, Sana, and other governance/reporting tools).
  • Experience in biotech, healthcare, or other large-scale companies.

Compensation & Total Rewards

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and internal equity considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Annual performance incentive bonus

  • Long-term equity awards

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$128,800—$161,050 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. jobs.description:
CWS seeks an experienced Systems/Network Administrator Lead to lead enterprise systems and network administration supporting the U.S. Military Entrance Processing Command (USMEPCOM) Enterprise Network for Lifecycle, Information Support, and Technology (ENLIST) program. 

The Systems/Network Administrator Lead will be responsible for systems and network administration, operations and maintenance (O&M), and associated activities supporting platforms installed throughout the USMEPCOM enterprise. This individual will serve as the contractor's service owner for enterprise infrastructure services, ensuring systems consistently meet defined service levels while providing secure, reliable, and highly available operations. 

The Systems/Network Administrator Lead will provide technical leadership for enterprise servers, operating systems, databases, virtualization platforms, storage, collaboration technologies, cloud environments, and network infrastructure.

This position will also lead the Outage Response Team (ORT), directing enterprise outage response, disaster recovery, Continuity of Operations (COOP), incident management, and restoration efforts while serving as the primary technical point of contact during major incidents. 

Working closely with Government leadership, engineering teams, cybersecurity personnel, vendors, and external partners, the Systems/Network Administrator Lead will ensure enterprise infrastructure remains secure, compliant, resilient, interoperable, and mission-ready. 

The successful candidate will possess exceptional technical leadership skills, extensive enterprise infrastructure experience, and the ability to lead geographically dispersed technical teams supporting a complex Department of Defense IT enterprise. 

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    • Lead enterprise systems administration, network operations, and operations and maintenance (O&M) activities across the USMEPCOM enterprise. 

    • Serve as the contractor's service owner for enterprise infrastructure services and ensure systems consistently meet defined service level objectives. 

    • Plan, organize, and direct contractor personnel responsible for operations and maintenance of USMEPCOM-constructed networks. 

    • Provide technical leadership for Windows and UNIX/Linux operating systems, physical and virtual servers, databases, VMware ESXi environments, Storage Area Networks (SANs), collaboration tools, enterprise applications, and cloud infrastructure. 

    • Perform system-level configuration, validation, integration, and administration of enterprise hardware, software, operating systems, and infrastructure platforms while maintaining interoperability with existing legacy systems. 

    • Lead engineering development, infrastructure integration, interface design analysis, software and hardware testing, and enterprise systems implementation activities. 

    • Apply Risk Management Framework (RMF) security principles, practices, and procedures to maintain compliance with Department of Defense cybersecurity requirements. 

    • Lead the Outage Response Team (ORT) and direct all activities associated with enterprise outage response, incident management, disaster recovery, and Continuity of Operations (COOP). 

    • Serve as the primary point of contact during enterprise outages, coordinating response activities with Government leadership, vendors, DISA, external agencies, and other stakeholders. 

    • Coordinate, direct, and oversee outage resolution efforts while providing timely status updates to Government leadership throughout incident response activities. 

    • Develop, maintain, and regularly update enterprise outage response procedures, Incident Response Plans, disaster recovery documentation, and operational playbooks. 

    • Review Incident Response Plans quarterly to ensure system inventories, procedures, documentation, and operational processes remain current. 

    • Lead geographically dispersed teams responsible for enterprise infrastructure operations, systems administration, and network support. 

    • Monitor enterprise performance, availability, and operational health while proactively identifying opportunities for infrastructure improvements, automation, and operational efficiencies. 

    • Support cloud technologies, virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI), enterprise networking, firewall administration, secure communications, and enterprise modernization initiatives. 

    • Foster continuous improvement while ensuring compliance with Federal Government, Department of Defense, and enterprise IT operational standards and best practices. 

Education & Experience

    • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, or a related technical discipline is preferred. 

    • Minimum five (5) years recent experience managing enterprise IT teams in geographically dispersed locations supporting operations and maintenance of enterprise servers (physical and virtual), operating systems (Windows and UNIX/Linux), databases, VMware ESXi, Storage Area Networks (SANs), collaboration tools, enterprise applications, scripting, and enterprise security. 

    • Minimum one (1) year recent experience:

    • Leading network personnel and coordinating enterprise outage response procedures

    • Supporting DISA network transport solutions.

    • Minimum five (5) years recent experience supporting:

    • Cloud-based enterprise solutions and cloud infrastructure

    • Virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) environments

    • In enterprise network and systems administration, including outage response and incident management

    • Leading enterprise network operations teams supporting programs similar in size, scope, and complexity to this Task Order

    • Minimum six (6) years recent experience supporting global enterprise network systems and subsystems, including LAN, WAN, MPLS, BGP, network availability, troubleshooting, and infrastructure optimization

    • Minimum three (3) years experience:

    • Supporting IPv4 and IPv6 protocol stacks

    • Planning and executing local and long-haul communications 

    • Supporting and troubleshooting firewall appliances, firewall rulesets, and enterprise firewall solutions

Certifications

    Must have or obtain all certifications required under DoDM 8140.03 Cyberspace Workforce Qualification and Management Program.

    • Must have an active ITIL® 4 Practice Manager Certification or ITIL® 4 Foundation Certification.

    • Candidates who do not currently possess the following certifications must obtain them within one month of hire. The company will sponsor certification training and examination costs as needed.

    • Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert (MCSE) certification.

    • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE) or Cisco Certified Design Expert (CCDE) certification.

    • At least one information security certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)).

    • At least two network certifications (e.g., Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), CompTIA Network+).

    • DoDI 8570.01 Information Assurance System Architect and Engineer (IASAE) Level III certification.

Security Clearance

  • Active Secret Clearance is required.

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

  • This position is primarily remote. Candidates located in the Chicago area are preferred, but this is not a requirement. Approximately 25% travel is anticipated during the first six months of the contract, primarily to the USMEPCOM Headquarters in North Chicago, Illinois, to support transition activities and program ramp-up. Once the program is fully operational, travel is expected to decrease to approximately 10% for periodic customer meetings and program support.

jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a Senior UX Interface Designer with a genuine, discerning visual sensibility who can recognize the difference between a screen that merely functions and one that commands attention, builds trust, and makes an athlete want to keep coming back.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior UX Interface Designer with a genuine, discerning visual sensibility who can recognize the difference between a screen that merely functions and one that commands attention, builds trust, and makes an athlete want to keep coming back. This is not a role for someone who executes a design system without aesthetic judgment. We need a designer who has a point of view, can defend it, and can elevate our product visually while remaining disciplined within our design constraints.

This role owns the Presentation Layer — how the product is formatted in terms of fonts, graphics, and animation, along with intuitive navigation. Key focus areas include innate visual design sensibility applied to a premium dark-surface consumer product; identity-driven, personalized experiences that adapt to each user's performance profile; high-quality motion and interaction design that communicates performance and progress; and action-oriented workflows that eliminate passive data consumption.

This is a startup environment where the ideal candidate thrives building from 0->1, is comfortable with ambiguity, and takes ownership rather than waiting for direction. We move fast, hold a high visual standard, and ship against hard dates. We also leverage modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate delivery; comfort in these environments is a must.

Key Tasks & Responsibilities

    Visual Design Leadership (Defining Responsibility)

    • Own the overall aesthetic standard of the product: typography application, spatial rhythm, depth hierarchy, color restraint, icon quality, and component polish
    • Ensure the product reads as a premium consumer tool — not a clinical health app, generic fitness tracker, or scaled-up spreadsheet
    • Apply visual judgment to commercial surfaces (marketplace, subscription tiers, upsell moments) while maintaining trust in the system
    • Build and maintain the authoritative Figma (or equivalent) design system: token library (colors, type ramps, spacing, radius, motion), component library, and identity cell documentation

      • Identity-Driven & Personalized Experience Design

      • Design the identity recoloring moment in onboarding as the signature emotional beat of the product — a real-time ambient palette transition that feels intentional, earned, and beautiful
      • Ensure the primary dashboard identity symbols function coherently as both the user's visual identity expression and the entry point to the AI coaching layer
      • Design the shareable identity card in both quiet (clean, restrained) and expressive (gamified, bold numbers) aesthetic modes
      • Ensure scoring loops, streak mechanics, and progression tier displays feel motivating and identity-consistent — not a generic gamification model

        • Motion Design & Interaction (Critical)

        • Design and spec all animated moments, including the readiness score arc animation, the pre-launch cinematic welcome experience, identity ambient recolor, mission/achievement completion states, AI coaching insight reveals, and score/pillar change reveals
        • Define motion standards for the full product: screen transitions, micro-interactions, press states, loading states, skeleton screens, empty states, and error states
        • Produce implementation-ready motion specs for multiple devices: Bodymovin/Lottie files, timing curves, duration values, and engineering handoff notes

          • UX/UI Design Across the Full Screen Inventory

          • Design action-oriented experiences that tell the user what to do next; every screen should have a clear direction rather than a passive display of data
          • Translate complex biomarker, wearable, and AI-generated data into interfaces that are immediately readable and emotionally resonant — not dense, clinical, or overwhelming
          • Design the dashboard priority engine as the product's daily engagement surface — one that feels like a coach, not a notification list
          • Design an AI coaching modal as a distinct experience layer, and maintain high-fidelity designs across iOS, Android, and Web simultaneously (design once, build anywhere)

            • Cross-Platform Consistency & Engineering Collaboration

            Ensure a unified visual and interaction experience across iOS, Android, and Web — respecting platform-specific behaviors without fracturing the design system

Education & Experience

    • 5+ years of experience in UX/UI and product design, with at least 2 years designing for mobile (iOS/Android) at a consumer product company

      • Must Demonstrate

      • Understanding of color as a functional system communicating status, identity, causality, and trust
      • Proficiency in Figma or equivalent — component libraries, auto-layout, design tokens, prototyping, and developer handoff
      • Proficiency in motion/animation tools (Lottie, After Effects, Framer, or equivalent) with demonstrated ability to spec animations for engineering implementation
      • Comfort with AI-assisted development tools such as Lovable, Cursor, or similar, and willingness to adopt new tooling quickly

        • Preferred Qualifications

        • Experience designing for health, fitness, performance, or biomarker applications
        • Experience designing consumer commerce surfaces in a trust-sensitive context, including in-app purchases, subscription tier presentations, or health/telehealth marketplaces
        • Familiarity with React Native / Expo design constraints: safe areas, platform-specific scroll physics, gesture models, and native component behavior
        • Light front-end knowledge (TypeScript, React Native, CSS) sufficient to assess implementation fidelity and communicate specific divergence from design intent
        • Experience designing gamification and progression systems: achievement states, streak mechanics, leaderboard displays, tier progression
        • Familiarity with identity-adaptive or multi-theme design systems: real-time palette shifts, persona-keyed visual treatments, multi-tier token management
        • Experience with cinematic or motion-heavy product moments (brand launch surfaces, product reveal animations, celebration states) and demonstrated ability to art-direct sound, motion, and timing together

Certifications

  • Applicable certifications are a plus

Other (Travel, Work Environment, DoD 8570 Requirements, Administrative Notes, etc.)

    • Fast-paced, milestone-driven startup environment with hard ship dates; role leverages AI-assisted development tools (Cursor, Lovable, and equivalents) to accelerate design and development velocity
    • This position is a remote work from home role

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Sr. Regulatory Affairs Specialist is responsible for the preparation of regulatory submissions required to market new or modified medical devices and in vitro diagnostic devices in both domestic and international clinical markets. This responsibility entails development, execution and management of procedures and systems designed to ensure that the product development process, including clinical studies, addresses all regulatory requirements as well as the objectives of the business.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Understands and interprets U.S. and EU and international medical device and in vitro diagnostic device (IVD) regulatory requirements.

  • Provides guidance on requirements to product development teams.

  • Develops strategies for submissions to FDA and other regulatory agencies.

  • Provides risk assessments and regulatory options.

  • Prepares U.S. regulatory submissions necessary for new product market clearance/approval and product continuance: 510(k)s; Pre-market Approval Applications (PMA) and supplements; Product Development Protocols (PDP); Investigational Device Exemptions (IDE); Pre-Submissions and supplements. Prepares and/or compiles information required by ex-U.S. regulatory associates to register or license products outside the U.S. Interacts and negotiates with U.S. regulatory agencies.

  • Coordinates the preparation of additional data/information requested by regulatory agencies and prepares appropriate responses to all such requests.

  • Participates in the development and review of product release documents.

  • Reviews clinical protocols to assure collection of appropriate data for regulatory submissions.

  • Periodically monitors status of clinical studies and reviews analysis of resultant clinical study data.

  • Based on these data and considering the regulatory requirements, recommends appropriate courses of action.

  • Reviews labels, labeling, and promotional materials for compliance with applicable regulations and policies.

  • Provides regulatory opinions on premarket regulatory requirements, export, and labeling requirements.

  • This role will have occasional access to PHI both in paper and electronic form and have occasional access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job.

  • Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent; degree in biological sciences, chemistry, or related science strongly preferred.

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in the device/diagnostic, biologic and/or pharmaceutical industry, preferably in the area of regulatory affairs or equivalent.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Current knowledge of U.S. medical device and in vitro diagnostic regulatory requirements, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Quality System Regulations (QSR); current knowledge of European Medical Device and IVD Directive requirements and European quality system standards.

jobs.excerpt: Role Description: Defense Unicorns seeks an experienced Software Engineer to help build, maintain, and steward our open source products and the broader ecosystems they depend on.
jobs.description:
Role Description:

Defense Unicorns seeks an experienced Software Engineer to help build, maintain, and steward our open source products and the broader ecosystems they depend on. You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, designers, engineers, community contributors, and end users to ensure we’re building the right solutions—and building them well.

As an Open Source Software Engineer, you’ll operate at the intersection of community stewardship, product development, and technical execution. You’ll help lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of cloud native software that has direct impact on mission outcomes.

You bring strong Golang experience, a love for cloud native technologies and a willingness to learn TypeScript to support our broader OSS ecosystem. Over time, you may also contribute across additional languages and communities, including Rust, as our open source work evolves.

Responsibilities:

  • Work with internal engineers and open source community contributors on features, bug fixes, reviews, and releases through clear communication, collaboration, and responsible stewardship
  • Engage with open source communities, industry partners, and standards bodies via common platforms (e.g., Slack, GitHub, etc.) to help move our projects and their upstream ecosystems forward, including facilitating community meetings with our internal and external users
  • Amplify the voice of our projects within the ecosystem by delivering a mission-focused end-user experience and collaborating with users to produce case studies, blogs, or conference presentations
  • Proactively identify and resolve ambiguity across product requirements, community needs, and upstream project constraints
  • Comfortable working proactively, managing time efficiently, and thriving in a vibrant remote work environment ✨🦄
  • Build and integrate secure, interoperable cloud native software for defense environments while contributing improvements back to relevant open source projects where appropriate
  • Own architecture decisions and ensure technical quality across open source codebases, APIs, and contributor workflows
  • Develop comprehensive documentation, including design proposals, contribution guides, user documentation, and maintenance guides
  • Stay abreast of emerging cloud native, open source, and secure software supply chain technologies to inform product enhancements and ecosystem contributions
  • Provide technical mentorship and elevate engineering standards across the team
  • Influence product direction through deep understanding of user needs and system constraints

Travel Expectations/Requirements: 5-15%

The listed responsibilities are not exhaustive and additional responsibilities may be assigned based on the evolving needs of the organization. We are seeking a dynamic individual who is able to adapt and take on new responsibilities as they arise.

Preferred Experience and Qualifications:

  • 5+ years experience with software engineering
  • Experience building or maintaining open source software tools, especially in cloud native, software lifecycle, or software supply chain domains
  • Proficient in Go, with interest in learning TypeScript, and contributing across additional modern languages such as Rust
  • Strong understanding of system design, library and software APIs, Kubernetes, and cloud architecture (e.g., AWS, Azure)
  • Excited to assess intricate problems, propose solutions, and implement them effectively
  • Experience contributing to open source projects and participating in open source communities. Involvement with the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF), Apache Software Foundation (ASF), Open Source Security Foundation (OpenSSF), or similar communities is a huge plus
  • Familiar with core Kubernetes concepts, including but not limited to controllers, operators, and CRDs
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, comfortable conveying technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience. Compensation ranges are established using national benchmarking data and apply across all geographic locations within the United States.

Remote - USA
$148,750—$201,250 USD

Who We Are

Defense Unicorns delivers mission value by streamlining software delivery so our customers can focus on the most important challenges. We share a vision of freedom and security for the advancement of progress and innovation. Our commitment to this vision, and to our mission-driven customers, means a commitment to speed, user experience and optionality, without compromising security. Our team is composed of innovators, software engineers, and veterans with decades of experience delivering technology programs across the federal market.

What We Do

We create and deliver secure solutions for continuous software integration and delivery. Defense Unicorns consolidates the best practices for security pipelines, testing, and deployment automation in order to meet the high security requirements valued by mission owners. Our solutions are agnostic by design and we believe that growing a robust ecosystem of secure, cloud-native software solutions can help enterprise customers inside and outside the federal market buy and integrate software more easily.

Who We Serve

Defense Unicorns’ customers are mission-focused leaders across public and private enterprises. We proudly support defense and civil agencies across the U.S. government and we work closely with the creators of leading-edge software solutions to deliver value to the mission-owner by improving the security and consumability of commercial software products.

What We Work On

  • Kubernetes
  • Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP and Azure)
  • Infrastructure-as-code (like Terraform/Pulumi)
  • Continuous Delivery and automation tooling
  • GitOps
  • Containers
  • CNCF projects and open source products and packages
  • Helm/Kustomize-Value Stream Mapping
  • Building and improving security delivery
  • Building Kubernetes and cloud native applications

Benefits Our Unicorns Enjoy

Health:

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • Premiums are 100% Company Paid
  • Health Savings Account
  • Life Insurance
  • Disability Insurance

Financial:

  • 401k Retirement Plan
  • Company Stock Options
  • Home Office Budget

Leave:

  • We offer all full-time Unicorns Flexible Time Off (FTO) plus all Federal Holidays, one week for Thanksgiving, and two weeks for Christmas and New Year’s
  • Paid Parental Leave

Learning:

  • Reimbursement for approved trainings/subscriptions
  • Conferences (travel, lodging, and fees)

Don’t have all the preferred experience or qualifications? Studies show that underrepresented groups like women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs if they don't meet every requirement listed.

At Defense Unicorns, we're committed to diversity. If you're enthusiastic about the role but don't match every criteria, we encourage you to apply. You could be the perfect fit for this or another role! Defense Unicorns is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

jobs.excerpt: About UsAt Sleep Doctor, we’re helping millions get a full night's rest.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Sleep Doctor, we’re helping millions get a full night's rest. As the most trusted name in sleep health, we make better sleep possible with proven support, clear answers, and hands-on care that fits real life. Across our brands—SleepDoctor.com, SleepFoundation.org, and SleepApnea.org—we combine clinical expertise with consumer-first experiences to help people understand their sleep, tackle real challenges, and wake up to healthier, more energized lives. If you’re passionate about making better sleep possible—and want to help reshape the future of sleep care—we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

The People Operations Manager reports to the Senior Director of People. This is a remote position. Regular attendance at a company office is not required, although there might be travel as needed for business needs.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building scalable HR processes while serving as a trusted partner to leaders and employees. You'll help oversee day-to-day People Operations functions—including HR operations, employee relations, recruiting, performance management, compliance, compensation administration, and benefits—helping create an exceptional employee experience across a growing, multi-state organization.

What You'll Do

HR Operations

  • Manage all core HR operations, including onboarding, offboarding, employee records, HRIS administration, and PEO partnership.
  • Ensure HR processes are efficient, scalable, compliant, and employee-focused.
  • Maintain accurate employee data, reporting, and HR documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve systems and streamline workflows.

Employee Relations

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to managers and employees on employee relations matters.
  • Coach managers through performance concerns, workplace issues, and difficult conversations.
  • Support investigations, documentation, corrective actions, and conflict resolution while ensuring consistency and fairness.

Performance Management

  • Administer the company's performance management program, including goal setting, performance reviews, calibration, and employee development.
  • Partner with managers to improve coaching, feedback, and accountability.
  • Track completion and ensure a consistent employee experience across the organization.

Recruiting & Onboarding

  • Manage recruiting operations from requisition through onboarding.
  • Partner with hiring managers to deliver an exceptional candidate experience.
  • Oversee interview scheduling, offers, background checks, onboarding, and new hire orientation.
  • Manage employee referral programs and recruiting processes.

Benefits Administration

  • Partner with brokers, benefit vendors, and our PEO to ensure smooth administration of employee benefits.
  • Support employees by answering benefit questions and resolving benefit-related issues.
  • Assist with annual open enrollment and ongoing benefit communications.

Compliance

  • Help maintain compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws while partnering with General Counsel on complex matters.
  • Update HR policies and procedures as regulations evolve.
  • Support audits and ensure HR documentation is complete, accurate, and compliant.

Compensation & HR Programs

  • Administer annual compensation review and bonus processes.
  • Prepare HR reports, compensation analyses, and workforce metrics to support leadership decision-making.
  • Support ongoing People programs and initiatives that enhance employee engagement and organizational effectiveness.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of progressive Human Resources or People Operations experience.
  • Experience supporting organizations (or divisions) with 50+ employees in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Healthcare experience strongly preferred, particularly supporting a Physician Corporation (PC) and Management Services Organization (MSO) structure.
  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state employment laws.
  • Experience administering HRIS platforms (such as Gusto) and partnering with a PEO (such as Prestige).
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Passion for building a positive, high-performing company culture.
  • Excellent judgment, discretion, and ability to manage highly confidential information.
  • Outstanding communication, collaboration, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to think strategically while also executing day-to-day operational work.
  • Self-starter who thrives in a collaborative, evolving environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field.
  • SHRM-CP, SHRM-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification.
  • Experience supporting fully distributed, multi-state teams.
  • Experience working in high-growth startups or digital healthcare organizations.

Who We Are

  • We’re committed to a vision of millions waking rested and ready.
  • We are Human First because our patients and teammates are why we’re here.
  • We are growing rapidly but sustainably because we are committed to Relentless Progress.
  • Run into a challenge or a new opportunity? We tackle it as a team because we know that we are Stronger Together.
  • We’re going to push you to ask big questions and find bold answers. Everyone has a seat at the table, regardless of their title or job description

Compensation Range

$120,000 - $130,000. Note that final compensation is subject to the candidate’s specific qualifications and location, as well as the needs of the company. This position is eligible to participate in the company’s bonus program.

The Company currently provides medical, vision, and dental insurance and 100% of the employee medical, vision, and dental premiums covered by the Company. There is an option to participate in both a medical FSA and dependent care FSA. We offer a 401(k) plan, with fully matching contributions up to 3% of salary and 50% matching from 3% to 5% of salary. There is a company paid life-insurance policy, and the option to participate in a voluntary pet-insurance policy. You will be eligible for Paid Time Off in accordance with the company’s policies.

Sleep Doctor is committed to bringing together individuals from diverse backgrounds and perspectives. We strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and be their authentic self, feel a sense of community, and do great work together. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer open to all qualified applicants.
